BMS-3854· PR #537

POS Deployment Visibility — campaigns, driver capture, dashboard

Jira: In ProgressStory Epic BMS-5093 · REQ-166 Data-ModelOMSOMS-UIWMS/WMS-UI labels: gulf · RTM · crawl

Adds the deployment-visibility record + reporting layer on top of the existing POS ordering pipeline. New Tier-0 objects POS_Deployment__c (per-account status, reason codes, geotag, offline-conflict flag) and POS_Campaign__c; a driver capture LWC (offline-capable, photo + geolocation) and a Marketing dashboard LWC (map pins, compliance report, 4-week ROI vs control group, CSV export); plus a POS material badge on warehouse transfer lines. View PR ↗ · BMS-3854 ↗

Implementation Narrative

What was built · file-by-file · key decisions · review status

What was built. A full POS-deployment tracking feature spanning four packages. Tier-0 schema (POS_Deployment__c + POS_Campaign__c) carries the deployment record with lookup seams to Invoice_Item__c and Transfer__c. A single large OMS-UI controller (POSDeploymentController, 1.5k lines) drives assignment creation, offline-batch driver sync with cancelled-assignment conflict handling, dashboard aggregates, a compliance report, and a 4-week pre/post ROI analysis against a same-territory control group. Two LWCs deliver the driver capture (mobile-first geolocation, photo, localStorage offline queue) and the Marketing dashboard (lightning-map, color-coded pins, CSV export with formula-injection guard). A POS material badge is added to warehouse transfer-to-truck lines.

Acceptance Criteria (6 Gherkin scenarios)
Driver records deployment at an account
Handheld shows assigned POS items (type/qty/instructions); mark Deployed / Not Deployed (reason code) / Deferred; photo per item; timestamped + geotagged; syncs offline.
Marketing views status across accounts
Dashboard map with color-coded pins (green/red/yellow/gray); rate %; click pin → history + photo; CSV export.
POS materials tracked through transfer
POS materials as real transfer line items linking to deployment assignments; visible on driver load sheet. (Partial — transfer badge + link seam ship; inventory decrement is out of scope.)
Compliance report for missing placements
Per-account expected vs actual date, driver, photo status; grouped by territory with % compliance; reason-coded non-compliance; route-level drill-down.
Offline capture syncs without data loss
Offline confirmations sync on reconnect w/ original timestamp + geo; photos upload; cancelled-while-offline → Conflict flag for manual review; sync count confirmation.
Deployment linked to sales performance
ROI view: 4-week pre/post avg weekly case volume, deployed vs same-territory control group; lift % at campaign + account level; auditable sources.

Key Decisions

  1. Parallel record, not a mutation of the POS-order flow. POS_Deployment__c runs alongside the existing Invoice_Item__c POS flags; the Invoice_Item__c lookup is the linking seam, but no automatic sync ships this phase (dispositioned follow-up).
  2. Offline-first driver capture via localStorage queue + lightning/mobileCapabilities geolocation (browser geolocation was replaced during code review), with cancelled-while-offline assignments preserved under an Is_Conflict__c flag for manual review rather than dropped.
  3. ROI as pre/post vs a same-territory control group — 4 weeks before/after, compared against non-deployed accounts in the same territory, computed in Apex.
  4. Defensive dashboard/report queries — row caps (2000/5000) and a CSV formula-injection guard were added during the internal review pass (commit 42fc85bc3).
  5. API-first surfaces. createDeploymentAssignments / linkTransferToDeployments are the designed admin-assignment and transfer-linking API; no UI caller ships yet.

Review Status — ⚠️ 4 WARNINGs, currently unaddressed on the PR

A /code-review pass by alv-sanchez raised 4 WARNINGs. None has an author reply on the PR; I verified findings #1 and #2 against the current head — both still present. #4 is acknowledged as a deferred follow-up in the PR body.

WARNINGOPENHighest priority. POSDeploymentController.cls:397 — offline-sync updates list has no dedup on deploymentId. A repeated Id (offline retry overlapping a live save) → System.ListException: Duplicate id in list, a pre-DML error that allOrNone=false does not suppress, sinking the whole batch. Fix: last-wins into a Map<Id, POS_Deployment__c>. (Confirmed still present at head.) WARNINGOPENPOSDeploymentController.cls:188 — createDeploymentAssignments dedups only against existing DB rows, not within the incoming accountIds. A double-submit inserts two active assignments for the same account. Fix: Set<Id> the input. (Confirmed still present at head — loop iterates the raw list.) WARNINGOPENTransferToTruckController.cls — doUpdate(...,false) discards the List<Database.SaveResult>; a row-level failure is dropped silently (Transfer never stamped, nothing logged). Fix: inspect SaveResults + Logger failed rows. WARNINGDEFERREDposDeploymentQueue.js — 3rd near-duplicate of posDeliveryQueue.js offline-queue logic. Acknowledged in the PR body as a shared-util extraction follow-up.

Also outstanding (PR checklist, not yet ticked): pool-org Apex run + ≥90% coverage, Chrome DevTools live smoke, Playwright dashboard spec pass, /document. Jira still In Progress; PR is pre-ready-for-review. Jest 1,540 green; prettier/eslint clean.

147+ >BMS-3854 (POS Deployment Visibility). A POS Campaign is a time-boxed, org-level initiative (e.g. a summer patio-set rollout, a holiday display push) that groups the individual POS_Deployment__c assignments created to execute it. It carries the campaign's planning window (Start_Date__c/End_Date__c), the date by which field reps must have all associated deployments completed (Deployment_Deadline__c), and a lifecycle Status__c so merchandising leadership can see at a glance whether a wave of POS placements is still being planned, actively rolling out, finished, or scrapped. Standalone object (no master-detail parent) — a campaign is authored centrally and only referenced by the deployments it spawns, never owned by an Account or Item.</description>

2+<CustomField xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
3+ <fullName>Status__c</fullName>
4+ <description
5+ >BMS-3854 (POS Deployment Visibility). Lifecycle stage of the campaign as a whole, distinct from the per-record Status__c on the individual POS_Deployment__c assignments it spawns. Planning campaigns are still being scoped (no deployments assigned yet, or assignment in progress); Active campaigns have deployments actively being executed in the field; Completed campaigns have reached their Deployment_Deadline__c with all deployments in a terminal state; Cancelled campaigns were scrapped before or during rollout. Dedicated restricted picklist — deliberately not the shared Status global value set, since campaign-level stages don't map 1:1 to deployment-level stages.</description>
6+ <externalId>false</externalId>
7+ <inlineHelpText>The current lifecycle stage of this campaign.</inlineHelpText>
8+ <label>Status</label>
9+ <required>false</required>
10+ <trackHistory>false</trackHistory>

18+ <default>true</default>
19+ <label>Planning</label>
20+ </value>
21+ <value>
22+ <fullName>Active</fullName>
23+ <default>false</default>
24+ <label>Active</label>
25+ </value>
26+ <value>
27+ <fullName>Completed</fullName>
28+ <default>false</default>
29+ <label>Completed</label>
30+ </value>
31+ <value>
32+ <fullName>Cancelled</fullName>
33+ <default>false</default>
34+ <label>Cancelled</label>
35+ </value>
36+ </valueSetDefinition>
37+ </valueSet>
38+</CustomField>

145+ <deploymentStatus>Deployed</deploymentStatus>
146+ <description
147+ >BMS-3854 (POS Deployment Visibility). A POS Deployment is the record of a single point-of-sale material assignment — one Item__c destined for one Account, optionally grouped under a POS_Campaign__c — tracked from assignment through field confirmation. It gives merchandising and sales leadership a queryable, reportable record of what POS material was assigned where, whether it was actually deployed, and why not when it wasn't (Reason_Code__c/Conflict_Reason__c), closing the visibility gap where POS placement previously lived only in ad hoc notes or wasn't tracked at all. Master-detail child of Account (sharingModel/security inherit from the account), with optional links back to the originating Invoice_Item__c (when the deployment was bundled with an order) or Transfer__c (when material moved via a warehouse transfer) for traceability.</description>

OHFY-OMS-UI/force-app/main/default/classes/controllers/posDeployment/POSDeploymentController.cls+1539-0
@@ -0,0 +1,1539 @@
1+/**
2+ * @description POS Deployment Visibility (BMS-3854). Gives admins visibility and control over
3+ * point-of-sale material deployment campaigns — assigning POS_Deployment__c rows to
4+ * accounts for a POS_Campaign__c, letting drivers record deployment outcomes at the
5+ * stop (including an offline-safe conflict path), and rolling the results up into a
6+ * dashboard, a compliance report, and an ROI analysis against a territory control
7+ * group.
8+ *
9+ * All reads go through QueryService (dynamic default AccessLevel); all writes go
10+ * through DmlService. Every @AuraEnabled entry point logs and rethrows as an
11+ * AuraHandledException so failures survive the Aura/LWC bridge with their message
12+ * intact (mirrors OMS_UI_Wrappers.auraError).
13+ *
14+ * @group POS Deployment
15+ **/
16+public with sharing class POSDeploymentController {
17+ // ── Shared constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
18+
19+ /** Terminal / non-open POS_Deployment__c statuses that should never be re-assigned or re-recorded. */
20+ private static final String STATUS_ASSIGNED = 'Assigned';
21+ private static final String STATUS_DEPLOYED = 'Deployed';
22+ private static final String STATUS_NOT_DEPLOYED = 'Not Deployed';
23+ private static final String STATUS_DEFERRED = 'Deferred';
24+ private static final String STATUS_CANCELLED = 'Cancelled';
25+
26+ private static final Set<String> DRIVER_RECORDABLE_STATUSES = new Set<String>{
27+ STATUS_DEPLOYED,
28+ STATUS_NOT_DEPLOYED,
29+ STATUS_DEFERRED
30+ };
31+
32+ /** Conflict note stamped when a driver's offline-recorded status lands after the assignment was cancelled. */
33+ private static final String CANCELLED_CONFLICT_REASON = 'Assignment cancelled while deployment was recorded offline';
34+
35+ public virtual class POSDeploymentException extends Exception {
36+ }
37+
38+ // ── auraError shell (mirrors OMS_UI_Wrappers.auraError) ──────────────────
39+
40+ /**
41+ * Logs the failure durably and rethrows as an AuraHandledException whose message survives the
42+ * Aura bridge (setMessage is required — the constructor message is otherwise replaced with the
43+ * generic "Script-thrown exception" on the client).
44+ */
45+ private static AuraHandledException auraError(String context, Exception e) {
46+ Logger.getInstance().error(context, e);
47+ Logger.getInstance().flush();
48+ AuraHandledException toThrow = new AuraHandledException(e.getMessage());
49+ toThrow.setMessage(e.getMessage());
50+ return toThrow;
51+ }
52+
53+ // ── 1. getCampaigns ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
54+
55+ /** How far back a Completed/Cancelled campaign is still surfaced as "recent". */
56+ private static final Integer RECENT_CAMPAIGN_WINDOW_DAYS = 30;
57+
58+ /**
59+ * @description Active + recently-completed POS_Campaign__c rows for the campaign filter picker.
60+ * Returned as raw sObjects (Id/Name plus the campaign header fields) — the LWC
61+ * consumer only needs Id/Name for its dropdown today, but the full row is returned
62+ * so a future admin surface can read the other campaign header fields without a
63+ * second round trip.
64+ * @return List<POS_Campaign__c> campaigns ordered by Start_Date__c descending.
65+ */
66+ @AuraEnabled(cacheable=false)
67+ public static List<POS_Campaign__c> getCampaigns() {
68+ try {
69+ Date recentCutoff = Date.today().addDays(-RECENT_CAMPAIGN_WINDOW_DAYS);
70+ return (List<POS_Campaign__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
71+ new List<String>{
72+ 'Id',
73+ 'Name',
74+ 'Start_Date__c',
75+ 'End_Date__c',
76+ 'Deployment_Deadline__c',
77+ 'Status__c',
78+ 'Description__c'
79+ },
80+ 'POS_Campaign__c'
81+ )
82+ .filters(
83+ new List<String>{
84+ 'Status__c != :cancelledStatus',
85+ '(End_Date__c = null OR End_Date__c >= :recentCutoff OR Status__c = :activeStatus)'
86+ }
87+ )
88+ .orderBy(new List<String>{ 'Start_Date__c DESC NULLS LAST' })
89+ .build()
90+ .execute(
91+ new Map<String, Object>{
92+ 'cancelledStatus' => STATUS_CANCELLED,
93+ 'recentCutoff' => recentCutoff,
94+ 'activeStatus' => 'Active'
95+ }
96+ );
97+ } catch (Exception e) {
98+ throw auraError('POSDeploymentController.getCampaigns', e);
99+ }
100+ }
101+
102+ // ── 2. createDeploymentAssignments ─────────────────────────────────────────
103+
104+ /**
105+ * @description Admin bulk-assigns POS_Deployment__c rows (Status='Assigned') to a set of
106+ * accounts for a campaign + item. Skips any account that already has a
107+ * non-cancelled assignment for that campaign + item, so re-running the assignment
108+ * flow (e.g. adding more accounts) never duplicates existing assignments.
109+ * @param requestJson `{ campaignId, itemId, quantity, expectedDate, placementInstructions,
110+ * accountIds: [] }`.
111+ * @return the number of POS_Deployment__c rows created.
112+ */
113+ @AuraEnabled
114+ public static Integer createDeploymentAssignments(String requestJson) {
115+ try {
116+ Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(
117+ requestJson,
118+ 'POSDeploymentController.createDeploymentAssignments'
119+ );
120+
121+ Id campaignId = (Id) req.get('campaignId');
122+ Id itemId = (Id) req.get('itemId');
123+ if (campaignId == null || itemId == null) {
124+ throw new POSDeploymentException(
125+ U_ParseErrorMessage.wrapErrorMessage(
126+ 'A campaign and an item are required to create deployment assignments.'
127+ )
128+ );
129+ }
130+
131+ Object rawQuantity = req.get('quantity');
132+ Decimal quantity = toDecimal(rawQuantity);
133+ // toDecimal swallows a parse failure (needed so a malformed offline lat/long doesn't
134+ // sink a sync batch elsewhere) and returns null — but here a caller-supplied quantity
135+ // that fails to parse is a real input error, not an absent value, and must not silently
136+ // insert a null-quantity assignment.
137+ if (rawQuantity != null && quantity == null) {
138+ throw new POSDeploymentException(
139+ U_ParseErrorMessage.wrapErrorMessage('Quantity must be a number.')
140+ );
141+ }
142+ Date expectedDate = toDate(req.get('expectedDate'));
143+ String placementInstructions = (String) req.get('placementInstructions');
144+
145+ // Set, not List — a double-submit or multi-select bug repeating an account Id in the
146+ // request must not create two active assignments for the same account/item/campaign.
147+ Set<Id> accountIds = new Set<Id>();
148+ Object rawAccountIds = req.get('accountIds');
149+ if (rawAccountIds != null) {
150+ for (Object rawId : (List<Object>) rawAccountIds) {
151+ if (rawId != null) {
152+ accountIds.add((Id) rawId);
153+ }
154+ }
155+ }
156+ if (accountIds.isEmpty()) {
157+ return 0;
158+ }
159+
160+ // Skip accounts that already have a non-cancelled assignment for this campaign + item.
161+ List<POS_Deployment__c> existing = (List<POS_Deployment__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
162+ new List<String>{ 'Id', 'Account__c' },
163+ 'POS_Deployment__c'
164+ )
165+ .filters(
166+ new List<String>{
167+ 'Account__c IN :accountIds',
168+ 'POS_Campaign__c = :campaignId',
169+ 'Item__c = :itemId',
170+ 'Status__c != :cancelledStatus'
171+ }
172+ )
173+ .build()
174+ .execute(
175+ new Map<String, Object>{
176+ 'accountIds' => accountIds,
177+ 'campaignId' => campaignId,
178+ 'itemId' => itemId,
179+ 'cancelledStatus' => STATUS_CANCELLED
180+ }
181+ );
182+ Set<Id> alreadyAssigned = new Set<Id>();
183+ for (POS_Deployment__c d : existing) {
184+ alreadyAssigned.add(d.Account__c);
185+ }
186+
187+ List<POS_Deployment__c> toInsert = new List<POS_Deployment__c>();
188+ for (Id accountId : accountIds) {
189+ if (alreadyAssigned.contains(accountId)) {
190+ continue;
191+ }
192+ toInsert.add(
193+ new POS_Deployment__c(
194+ Account__c = accountId,
195+ Item__c = itemId,
196+ POS_Campaign__c = campaignId,
197+ Quantity_Assigned__c = quantity,
198+ Placement_Instructions__c = placementInstructions,
199+ Expected_Deployment_Date__c = expectedDate,
200+ Status__c = STATUS_ASSIGNED
201+ )
202+ );
203+ }
204+
205+ if (!toInsert.isEmpty()) {
206+ DmlService.doInsert(toInsert, true);
207+ }
208+ return toInsert.size();
209+ } catch (Exception e) {
210+ throw auraError('POSDeploymentController.createDeploymentAssignments', e);
211+ }
212+ }
213+
214+ // ── 3. getDeploymentsForAccount ────────────────────────────────────────────
215+
216+ /** Open / not-yet-terminal statuses shown to a driver at the stop. */
217+ private static final Set<String> DRIVER_OPEN_STATUSES = new Set<String>{
218+ STATUS_ASSIGNED,
219+ STATUS_DEFERRED
220+ };
221+
222+ /**
223+ * @description Assigned/open POS_Deployment__c rows for a driver at an account's stop —
224+ * item, quantity, placement instructions, status, and campaign name.
225+ * @param accountId the retail account at the stop.
226+ * @return List<DeploymentStopDTO> open deployments for the account.
227+ */
228+ @AuraEnabled(cacheable=false)
229+ public static List<DeploymentStopDTO> getDeploymentsForAccount(Id accountId) {
230+ try {
231+ if (accountId == null) {
232+ return new List<DeploymentStopDTO>();
233+ }
234+ List<POS_Deployment__c> deployments = (List<POS_Deployment__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
235+ new List<String>{
236+ 'Id',
237+ 'Item__c',
238+ 'Item__r.Name',
239+ 'Item__r.Type__c',
240+ 'Quantity_Assigned__c',
241+ 'Placement_Instructions__c',
242+ 'Status__c',
243+ 'POS_Campaign__c',
244+ 'POS_Campaign__r.Name',
245+ 'Expected_Deployment_Date__c'
246+ },
247+ 'POS_Deployment__c'
248+ )
249+ .filters(
250+ new List<String>{ 'Account__c = :accountId', 'Status__c IN :openStatuses' }
251+ )
252+ .orderBy(new List<String>{ 'Expected_Deployment_Date__c ASC NULLS LAST' })
253+ .build()
254+ .execute(
255+ new Map<String, Object>{
256+ 'accountId' => accountId,
257+ 'openStatuses' => DRIVER_OPEN_STATUSES
258+ }
259+ );
260+
261+ List<DeploymentStopDTO> results = new List<DeploymentStopDTO>();
262+ for (POS_Deployment__c d : deployments) {
263+ DeploymentStopDTO dto = new DeploymentStopDTO();
264+ dto.id = d.Id;
265+ dto.itemId = d.Item__c;
266+ dto.itemName = d.Item__r != null ? d.Item__r.Name : null;
267+ dto.itemType = d.Item__r != null ? d.Item__r.Type__c : null;
268+ dto.quantity = d.Quantity_Assigned__c;
269+ dto.placementInstructions = d.Placement_Instructions__c;
270+ dto.status = d.Status__c;
271+ dto.campaignId = d.POS_Campaign__c;
272+ dto.campaignName = d.POS_Campaign__r != null ? d.POS_Campaign__r.Name : null;
273+ dto.expectedDeploymentDate = d.Expected_Deployment_Date__c;
274+ results.add(dto);
275+ }
276+ return results;
277+ } catch (Exception e) {
278+ throw auraError('POSDeploymentController.getDeploymentsForAccount', e);
279+ }
280+ }
281+
282+ // ── 4. recordDeploymentStatuses ────────────────────────────────────────────
283+
284+ /**
285+ * @description Driver sync endpoint — records single or offline-batched deployment outcomes.
286+ * When a deployment's current status is already Cancelled (e.g. an admin cancelled
287+ * the assignment while the driver was offline), the driver's reported status is
288+ * still preserved for audit purposes but flagged as a conflict rather than silently
289+ * overwriting or silently dropping the record.
290+ * @param payloadJson `[{ deploymentId, status, reasonCode, clientTimestamp, latitude, longitude,
291+ * hasPhoto }]`.
292+ * @return List<DeploymentSyncResultDTO> per-record `{deploymentId, success, conflict}` results so
293+ * the client can render "6 of 6 uploaded".
294+ */
295+ @AuraEnabled
296+ public static List<DeploymentSyncResultDTO> recordDeploymentStatuses(String payloadJson) {
297+ List<DeploymentSyncResultDTO> results = new List<DeploymentSyncResultDTO>();
298+ try {
299+ if (String.isBlank(payloadJson)) {
300+ return results;
301+ }
302+ List<Object> raw;
303+ try {
304+ raw = (List<Object>) JSON.deserializeUntyped(payloadJson);
305+ } catch (Exception parseEx) {
306+ Logger.getInstance()
307+ .error('POSDeploymentController.recordDeploymentStatuses parse', parseEx);
308+ Logger.getInstance().flush();
309+ throw new POSDeploymentException(
310+ U_ParseErrorMessage.wrapErrorMessage(
311+ 'The deployment status update could not be read.'
312+ )
313+ );
314+ }
315+
316+ List<SyncEntry> entries = new List<SyncEntry>();
317+ Set<Id> deploymentIds = new Set<Id>();
318+ for (Object o : raw) {
319+ Map<String, Object> row = (Map<String, Object>) o;
320+ Id deploymentId = (Id) row.get('deploymentId');
321+ if (deploymentId == null) {
322+ continue;
323+ }
324+ SyncEntry entry = new SyncEntry();
325+ entry.deploymentId = deploymentId;
326+ entry.status = (String) row.get('status');
327+ entry.reasonCode = (String) row.get('reasonCode');
328+ entry.clientTimestamp = (String) row.get('clientTimestamp');
329+ entry.latitude = toDecimal(row.get('latitude'));
330+ entry.longitude = toDecimal(row.get('longitude'));
331+ entry.hasPhoto = row.get('hasPhoto') == true;
332+ entries.add(entry);
333+ deploymentIds.add(deploymentId);
334+ }
335+
336+ if (entries.isEmpty()) {
337+ return results;
338+ }
339+
340+ Map<Id, POS_Deployment__c> existingById = new Map<Id, POS_Deployment__c>(
341+ (List<POS_Deployment__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
342+ new List<String>{ 'Id', 'Status__c' },
343+ 'POS_Deployment__c'
344+ )
345+ .filters(new List<String>{ 'Id IN :deploymentIds' })
346+ .build()
347+ .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'deploymentIds' => deploymentIds })
348+ );
349+
350+ // Dedup by deploymentId (last-wins) before building the update list — an offline
351+ // retry overlapping a live save can repeat a deploymentId in one payload, and two
352+ // SObjects sharing an Id in the same DML call throw a pre-DML ListException that
353+ // allOrNone=false cannot suppress, sinking the whole batch.
354+ Map<Id, SyncEntry> dedupedEntries = new Map<Id, SyncEntry>();
355+ for (SyncEntry entry : entries) {
356+ dedupedEntries.put(entry.deploymentId, entry);
357+ }
358+
359+ List<POS_Deployment__c> updates = new List<POS_Deployment__c>();
360+ // Parallel to `updates` (built in the same pass) — carries each row's already-computed
361+ // conflict flag forward so the result-building loop below doesn't need to re-derive it
362+ // from a re-fetched SyncEntry.
363+ List<Boolean> conflictFlags = new List<Boolean>();
364+ for (SyncEntry entry : dedupedEntries.values()) {
365+ POS_Deployment__c existing = existingById.get(entry.deploymentId);
366+ if (existing == null || !DRIVER_RECORDABLE_STATUSES.contains(entry.status)) {
367+ // Unknown record or an invalid status — report a non-conflict failure rather
368+ // than block the rest of the batch.
369+ DeploymentSyncResultDTO failure = new DeploymentSyncResultDTO();
370+ failure.deploymentId = entry.deploymentId;
371+ failure.success = false;
372+ failure.conflict = false;
373+ results.add(failure);
374+ continue;
375+ }
376+
377+ Boolean isConflict = existing.Status__c == STATUS_CANCELLED;
378+
379+ POS_Deployment__c deploymentUpdate = new POS_Deployment__c(Id = entry.deploymentId);
380+ // Preserve the driver's recorded status even over a cancelled assignment — the
381+ // conflict flag (not a silent overwrite) is what surfaces the discrepancy to admins.
382+ deploymentUpdate.Status__c = entry.status;
383+ deploymentUpdate.Reason_Code__c = entry.reasonCode;
384+ deploymentUpdate.Is_Photo_Attached__c = entry.hasPhoto;
385+ deploymentUpdate.Deployed_Date__c = parseClientTimestamp(entry.clientTimestamp);
386+ deploymentUpdate.Deployed_By__c = UserInfo.getUserId();
387+ if (entry.latitude != null) {
388+ deploymentUpdate.Deployment_Location__Latitude__s = entry.latitude;
389+ }
390+ if (entry.longitude != null) {
391+ deploymentUpdate.Deployment_Location__Longitude__s = entry.longitude;
392+ }
393+ if (isConflict) {
394+ deploymentUpdate.Is_Conflict__c = true;
395+ deploymentUpdate.Conflict_Reason__c = CANCELLED_CONFLICT_REASON;
396+ }
397+ updates.add(deploymentUpdate);
398+ conflictFlags.add(isConflict);
399+ }
400+
401+ if (!updates.isEmpty()) {
402+ // allOrNone=false: an isolated bad row (e.g. a stale conflicting update) must not
403+ // sink the rest of an offline batch — each row reports its own success/failure.
404+ List<Database.SaveResult> saveResults = DmlService.doUpdate(updates, false);
405+ for (Integer i = 0; i < saveResults.size(); i++) {
406+ Database.SaveResult sr = saveResults[i];
407+ DeploymentSyncResultDTO dto = new DeploymentSyncResultDTO();
408+ dto.deploymentId = updates[i].Id;
409+ dto.success = sr.isSuccess();
410+ dto.conflict = conflictFlags[i];
411+ results.add(dto);
412+ }
413+ }
414+ return results;
415+ } catch (Exception e) {
416+ throw auraError('POSDeploymentController.recordDeploymentStatuses', e);
417+ }
418+ }
419+
420+ /** Best-effort ISO-8601 client timestamp parse; falls back to server "now" when absent/unparseable. */
421+ private static Datetime parseClientTimestamp(String clientTimestamp) {
422+ if (String.isBlank(clientTimestamp)) {
423+ return Datetime.now();
424+ }
425+ try {
426+ return (Datetime) JSON.deserialize('"' + clientTimestamp + '"', Datetime.class);
427+ } catch (Exception e) {
428+ Logger.getInstance().error('POSDeploymentController.parseClientTimestamp', e);
429+ Logger.getInstance().flush();
430+ return Datetime.now();
431+ }
432+ }
433+
434+ /** Internal carrier for one parsed driver sync entry (never crosses a package boundary). */
435+ private class SyncEntry {
436+ Id deploymentId;
437+ String status;
438+ String reasonCode;
439+ String clientTimestamp;
440+ Decimal latitude;
441+ Decimal longitude;
442+ Boolean hasPhoto = false;
443+ }
444+
445+ // ── 5. getDashboardSummary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
446+
447+ /** Maps a POS_Deployment__c Status__c value to the LWC's map-pin status bucket key. */
448+ private static final Map<String, String> STATUS_TO_BUCKET = new Map<String, String>{
449+ STATUS_DEPLOYED => 'deployed',
450+ STATUS_NOT_DEPLOYED => 'notDeployed',
451+ STATUS_DEFERRED => 'deferred'
452+ };
453+ private static final String BUCKET_NO_ASSIGNMENT = 'noAssignment';
454+
455+ /**
456+ * Row caps for the raw-row (non-aggregate) queries, so an unfiltered dashboard or a very large
457+ * campaign degrades to a truncated view instead of a SOQL row LimitException. Ordered by
458+ * LastModifiedDate/Account so the truncation keeps the most recent rows per account first.
459+ */
460+ private static final Integer DASHBOARD_MAX_PIN_ROWS = 2000;
461+ private static final Integer COMPLIANCE_MAX_ROWS = 5000;
462+
463+ /**
464+ * @description Dashboard rollup for a campaign (optionally narrowed by material type /
465+ * territory): totals by status, the overall deployment rate, a per-territory
466+ * rollup, and per-account pin data (with a status bucket) for a map view.
467+ * @param filtersJson `{ campaignId, materialType, territoryId }`.
468+ * @return DashboardSummaryDTO.
469+ */
470+ @AuraEnabled(cacheable=false)
471+ public static DashboardSummaryDTO getDashboardSummary(String filtersJson) {
472+ try {
473+ Map<String, Object> filters = parseJsonObject(
474+ filtersJson,
475+ 'POSDeploymentController.getDashboardSummary'
476+ );
477+ Id campaignId = (Id) filters.get('campaignId');
478+ String materialType = (String) filters.get('materialType');
479+ Id territoryId = (Id) filters.get('territoryId');
480+
481+ List<String> soqlFilters = new List<String>();
482+ Map<String, Object> binds = new Map<String, Object>();
483+ if (campaignId != null) {
484+ soqlFilters.add('POS_Campaign__c = :campaignId');
485+ binds.put('campaignId', campaignId);
486+ }
487+ if (String.isNotBlank(materialType)) {
488+ soqlFilters.add('Item__r.Type__c = :materialType');
489+ binds.put('materialType', materialType);
490+ }
491+ if (territoryId != null) {
492+ soqlFilters.add('Account__r.Territory__c = :territoryId');
493+ binds.put('territoryId', territoryId);
494+ }
495+ if (soqlFilters.isEmpty()) {
496+ // 'Id != null' matches every row, so it is NOT a scope guard — the real bound for
497+ // the raw-row pin query below is DASHBOARD_MAX_PIN_ROWS; the aggregate queries are
498+ // bounded by their GROUP BY cardinality.
499+ soqlFilters.add('Id != null');
500+ }
501+
502+ DashboardSummaryDTO dto = new DashboardSummaryDTO();
503+
504+ // Totals by status.
505+ List<AggregateResult> statusCounts = (List<AggregateResult>) QueryService.newBuilder(
506+ new List<String>{ 'Status__c stat', 'COUNT(Id) cnt' },
507+ 'POS_Deployment__c'
508+ )
509+ .filters(soqlFilters)
510+ .groupBy(new List<String>{ 'Status__c' })
511+ .build()
512+ .execute(binds);
513+
514+ Integer cancelledCount = 0;
515+ for (AggregateResult ar : statusCounts) {
516+ String stat = (String) ar.get('stat');
517+ Integer cnt = (Integer) ar.get('cnt');
518+ if (stat == STATUS_DEPLOYED) {
519+ dto.deployed = cnt;
520+ } else if (stat == STATUS_NOT_DEPLOYED) {
521+ dto.notDeployed = cnt;
522+ } else if (stat == STATUS_DEFERRED) {
523+ dto.deferred = cnt;
524+ } else if (stat == STATUS_CANCELLED) {
525+ cancelledCount = cnt;
526+ }
527+ if (stat != STATUS_CANCELLED) {
528+ dto.totalAssigned += cnt;
529+ }
530+ }
531+ dto.deploymentRate = dto.totalAssigned > 0
532+ ? ((Decimal.valueOf(dto.deployed) / dto.totalAssigned) * 100).setScale(2)
533+ : 0;
534+
535+ // Per-territory rollup.
536+ List<AggregateResult> territoryCounts = (List<AggregateResult>) QueryService.newBuilder(
537+ new List<String>{
538+ 'Account__r.Territory__c tid',
539+ 'Account__r.Territory__r.Name tname',
540+ 'Status__c stat',
541+ 'COUNT(Id) cnt'
542+ },
543+ 'POS_Deployment__c'
544+ )
545+ .filters(soqlFilters)
546+ .groupBy(
547+ new List<String>{
548+ 'Account__r.Territory__c',
549+ 'Account__r.Territory__r.Name',
550+ 'Status__c'
551+ }
552+ )
553+ .build()
554+ .execute(binds);
555+
556+ Map<Id, TerritoryRollupDTO> territoryById = new Map<Id, TerritoryRollupDTO>();
557+ for (AggregateResult ar : territoryCounts) {
558+ Id tid = (Id) ar.get('tid');
559+ String stat = (String) ar.get('stat');
560+ Integer cnt = (Integer) ar.get('cnt');
561+ TerritoryRollupDTO rollup = territoryById.get(tid);
562+ if (rollup == null) {
563+ rollup = new TerritoryRollupDTO();
564+ rollup.territoryId = tid;
565+ rollup.territoryName = (String) ar.get('tname');
566+ territoryById.put(tid, rollup);
567+ }
568+ if (stat == STATUS_CANCELLED) {
569+ rollup.cancelledCount += cnt;
570+ } else {
571+ rollup.total += cnt;
572+ if (stat == STATUS_DEPLOYED) {
573+ rollup.deployed += cnt;
574+ }
575+ }
576+ }
577+ for (TerritoryRollupDTO rollup : territoryById.values()) {
578+ rollup.rate = rollup.total > 0
579+ ? ((Decimal.valueOf(rollup.deployed) / rollup.total) * 100).setScale(2)
580+ : 0;
581+ dto.territories.add(rollup);
582+ }
583+
584+ // Account pin data — most recent deployment per account within the same filter scope.
585+ List<POS_Deployment__c> accountRows = (List<POS_Deployment__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
586+ new List<String>{
587+ 'Account__c',
588+ 'Account__r.Name',
589+ 'Account__r.BillingLatitude',
590+ 'Account__r.BillingLongitude',
591+ 'Status__c',
592+ 'LastModifiedDate'
593+ },
594+ 'POS_Deployment__c'
595+ )
596+ .filters(soqlFilters)
597+ .orderBy(new List<String>{ 'Account__c', 'LastModifiedDate DESC' })
598+ .limitAmount(DASHBOARD_MAX_PIN_ROWS)
599+ .build()
600+ .execute(binds);
601+
602+ Set<Id> seenAccounts = new Set<Id>();
603+ for (POS_Deployment__c row : accountRows) {
604+ if (row.Account__c == null || seenAccounts.contains(row.Account__c)) {
605+ continue;
606+ }
607+ seenAccounts.add(row.Account__c);
608+ AccountPinDTO pin = new AccountPinDTO();
609+ pin.accountId = row.Account__c;
610+ pin.accountName = row.Account__r != null ? row.Account__r.Name : null;
611+ pin.latitude = row.Account__r != null ? row.Account__r.BillingLatitude : null;
612+ pin.longitude = row.Account__r != null ? row.Account__r.BillingLongitude : null;
613+ pin.statusBucket = STATUS_TO_BUCKET.containsKey(row.Status__c)
614+ ? STATUS_TO_BUCKET.get(row.Status__c)
615+ : BUCKET_NO_ASSIGNMENT;
616+ dto.accountPins.add(pin);
617+ }
618+
619+ return dto;
620+ } catch (Exception e) {
621+ throw auraError('POSDeploymentController.getDashboardSummary', e);
622+ }
623+ }
624+
625+ // ── 6. getAccountDeploymentHistory ────────────────────────────────────────
626+
627+ /**
628+ * @description The account's full POS deployment history — item, campaign, status, deployed
629+ * date/by, whether a compliance photo was captured, and (BMS-3854) the
630+ * destination route/truck that fulfilled it when the deployment was auto-linked
631+ * or manually stamped to a warehouse-to-truck Transfer__c.
632+ * @param accountId the retail account.
633+ * @return List<HistoryRowDTO> deployment history, most recent first.
634+ */
635+ @AuraEnabled(cacheable=false)
636+ public static List<HistoryRowDTO> getAccountDeploymentHistory(Id accountId) {
637+ try {
638+ if (accountId == null) {
639+ return new List<HistoryRowDTO>();
640+ }
641+ List<POS_Deployment__c> rows = (List<POS_Deployment__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
642+ new List<String>{
643+ 'Id',
644+ 'Item__r.Name',
645+ 'POS_Campaign__r.Name',
646+ 'Status__c',
647+ 'Deployed_Date__c',
648+ 'Deployed_By__r.Name',
649+ 'Is_Photo_Attached__c',
650+ 'Transfer__r.New_Location__c'
651+ },
652+ 'POS_Deployment__c'
653+ )
654+ .filters(new List<String>{ 'Account__c = :accountId' })
655+ .orderBy(new List<String>{ 'Deployed_Date__c DESC NULLS LAST', 'CreatedDate DESC' })
656+ .build()
657+ .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'accountId' => accountId });
658+
659+ Map<Id, String> truckLocationIdToRouteLabel = getTruckRouteLabelsByLocation(rows);
660+
661+ List<HistoryRowDTO> results = new List<HistoryRowDTO>();
662+ for (POS_Deployment__c row : rows) {
663+ HistoryRowDTO dto = new HistoryRowDTO();
664+ dto.deploymentId = row.Id;
665+ dto.itemName = row.Item__r != null ? row.Item__r.Name : null;
666+ dto.campaignName = row.POS_Campaign__r != null ? row.POS_Campaign__r.Name : null;
667+ dto.status = row.Status__c;
668+ dto.deployedDate = row.Deployed_Date__c;
669+ dto.deployedByName = row.Deployed_By__r != null ? row.Deployed_By__r.Name : null;
670+ dto.hasPhoto = row.Is_Photo_Attached__c;
671+ Id destinationLocationId = row.Transfer__r != null
672+ ? row.Transfer__r.New_Location__c
673+ : null;
674+ dto.truckRoute = destinationLocationId != null
675+ ? truckLocationIdToRouteLabel.get(destinationLocationId)
676+ : null;
677+ results.add(dto);
678+ }
679+ return results;
680+ } catch (Exception e) {
681+ throw auraError('POSDeploymentController.getAccountDeploymentHistory', e);
682+ }
683+ }
684+
685+ /**
686+ * @description BMS-3854. For the given deployment rows' linked Transfer__c destination
687+ * locations, resolves the Delivery__c whose Truck_Location__c matches — and
688+ * returns a display label ("Route <#> — <Vehicle Name>") keyed by that
689+ * destination Location__c Id, so the dashboard detail panel can show which
690+ * route/truck a deployment's material was routed on.
691+ */
692+ private static Map<Id, String> getTruckRouteLabelsByLocation(List<POS_Deployment__c> rows) {
693+ Map<Id, String> truckLocationIdToRouteLabel = new Map<Id, String>();
694+
695+ Set<Id> destinationLocationIds = new Set<Id>();
696+ for (POS_Deployment__c row : rows) {
697+ if (row.Transfer__r != null && row.Transfer__r.New_Location__c != null) {
698+ destinationLocationIds.add(row.Transfer__r.New_Location__c);
699+ }
700+ }
701+ if (destinationLocationIds.isEmpty()) {
702+ return truckLocationIdToRouteLabel;
703+ }
704+
705+ List<Delivery__c> deliveries = (List<Delivery__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
706+ new List<String>{
707+ 'Id',
708+ 'Truck_Location__c',
709+ 'Route__r.Route_Number__c',
710+ 'Vehicle__r.Name'
711+ },
712+ 'Delivery__c'
713+ )
714+ .filters(new List<String>{ 'Truck_Location__c IN :destinationLocationIds' })
715+ .build()
716+ .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'destinationLocationIds' => destinationLocationIds });
717+
718+ for (Delivery__c delivery : deliveries) {
719+ if (truckLocationIdToRouteLabel.containsKey(delivery.Truck_Location__c)) {
720+ continue;
721+ }
722+ String routeNumber = delivery.Route__r != null
723+ ? delivery.Route__r.Route_Number__c
724+ : null;
725+ String vehicleName = delivery.Vehicle__r != null ? delivery.Vehicle__r.Name : null;
726+ if (routeNumber == null && vehicleName == null) {
727+ continue;
728+ }
729+ String label =
730+ (routeNumber != null ? 'Route ' + routeNumber : 'Route —') +
731+ (vehicleName != null ? ' — ' + vehicleName : '');
732+ truckLocationIdToRouteLabel.put(delivery.Truck_Location__c, label);
733+ }
734+
735+ return truckLocationIdToRouteLabel;
736+ }
737+
738+ // ── 7. getComplianceReport ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
739+
740+ /**
741+ * @description Per-account compliance rows for a campaign (expected vs. actual deployment date,
742+ * deploying driver, photo capture, reason code, material name/type, active route),
743+ * plus per-territory compliance percentages computed server-side. Route is resolved
744+ * through the account's active Account_Route__c row.
745+ * @param campaignId the POS_Campaign__c being reported on.
746+ * @param materialType optional Item__c.Type__c narrowing (matches the dashboard filter).
747+ * @param territoryId optional Account__r.Territory__c narrowing (matches the dashboard filter).
748+ * @return ComplianceReportDTO.
749+ */
750+ @AuraEnabled(cacheable=false)
751+ public static ComplianceReportDTO getComplianceReport(
752+ Id campaignId,
753+ String materialType,
754+ Id territoryId
755+ ) {
756+ try {
757+ ComplianceReportDTO report = new ComplianceReportDTO();
758+ if (campaignId == null) {
759+ return report;
760+ }
761+
762+ List<String> soqlFilters = new List<String>{ 'POS_Campaign__c = :campaignId' };
763+ Map<String, Object> binds = new Map<String, Object>{ 'campaignId' => campaignId };
764+ if (String.isNotBlank(materialType)) {
765+ soqlFilters.add('Item__r.Type__c = :materialType');
766+ binds.put('materialType', materialType);
767+ }
768+ if (territoryId != null) {
769+ soqlFilters.add('Account__r.Territory__c = :territoryId');
770+ binds.put('territoryId', territoryId);
771+ }
772+
773+ List<POS_Deployment__c> rows = (List<POS_Deployment__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
774+ new List<String>{
775+ 'Id',
776+ 'Account__c',
777+ 'Account__r.Name',
778+ 'Account__r.Territory__c',
779+ 'Account__r.Territory__r.Name',
780+ 'Item__r.Name',
781+ 'Item__r.Type__c',
782+ 'Expected_Deployment_Date__c',
783+ 'Deployed_Date__c',
784+ 'Deployed_By__r.Name',
785+ 'Is_Photo_Attached__c',
786+ 'Reason_Code__c',
787+ 'Status__c'
788+ },
789+ 'POS_Deployment__c'
790+ )
791+ .filters(soqlFilters)
792+ .orderBy(new List<String>{ 'Account__r.Name ASC' })
793+ .limitAmount(COMPLIANCE_MAX_ROWS)
794+ .build()
795+ .execute(binds);
796+
797+ Map<Id, String> routeNameByAccountId = getActiveRouteNamesByAccount(rows);
798+
799+ Map<Id, TerritoryComplianceDTO> territoryById = new Map<Id, TerritoryComplianceDTO>();
800+ List<Id> territoryOrder = new List<Id>();
801+ for (POS_Deployment__c row : rows) {
802+ ComplianceRowDTO dto = new ComplianceRowDTO();
803+ dto.deploymentId = row.Id;
804+ dto.accountName = row.Account__r != null ? row.Account__r.Name : null;
805+ dto.routeName = routeNameByAccountId.get(row.Account__c);
806+ dto.itemName = row.Item__r != null ? row.Item__r.Name : null;
807+ dto.materialType = row.Item__r != null ? row.Item__r.Type__c : null;
808+ dto.expectedDate = row.Expected_Deployment_Date__c;
809+ dto.actualDate = row.Deployed_Date__c;
810+ dto.driverName = row.Deployed_By__r != null ? row.Deployed_By__r.Name : null;
811+ dto.hasPhoto = row.Is_Photo_Attached__c;
812+ dto.reasonCode = row.Reason_Code__c;
813+ dto.status = row.Status__c;
814+
815+ Id rowTerritoryId = row.Account__r != null ? row.Account__r.Territory__c : null;
816+ // Territory-less accounts still get their own labeled bucket rather than being
817+ // silently merged under a nameless null-keyed group with a misleading combined %.
818+ String territoryName = (row.Account__r != null &&
819+ row.Account__r.Territory__r != null)
820+ ? row.Account__r.Territory__r.Name
821+ : 'Unassigned';
822+ TerritoryComplianceDTO tCompliance = territoryById.get(rowTerritoryId);
823+ if (tCompliance == null) {
824+ tCompliance = new TerritoryComplianceDTO();
825+ tCompliance.territoryId = rowTerritoryId;
826+ tCompliance.territoryName = territoryName;
827+ territoryById.put(rowTerritoryId, tCompliance);
828+ territoryOrder.add(rowTerritoryId);
829+ }
830+ tCompliance.rows.add(dto);
831+ tCompliance.total++;
832+ if (row.Status__c == STATUS_DEPLOYED) {
833+ tCompliance.deployedCount++;
834+ }
835+ }
836+
837+ for (Id orderedTerritoryId : territoryOrder) {
838+ TerritoryComplianceDTO tCompliance = territoryById.get(orderedTerritoryId);
839+ tCompliance.compliancePct = tCompliance.total > 0
840+ ? ((Decimal.valueOf(tCompliance.deployedCount) / tCompliance.total) * 100)
841+ .setScale(2)
842+ : 0;
843+ report.territories.add(tCompliance);
844+ }
845+ return report;
846+ } catch (Exception e) {
847+ throw auraError('POSDeploymentController.getComplianceReport', e);
848+ }
849+ }
850+
851+ /**
852+ * @description Resolves each account's active route name through Account_Route__c so compliance
853+ * rows can show route-level detail (BMS-3854 AC 4). When an account has multiple
854+ * active routes, the first one returned wins — compliance reporting needs a label,
855+ * not a full route roster.
856+ * @param deployments compliance rows already queried for the campaign.
857+ * @return account Id → active route name.
858+ */
859+ private static Map<Id, String> getActiveRouteNamesByAccount(
860+ List<POS_Deployment__c> deployments
861+ ) {
862+ Map<Id, String> routeNameByAccountId = new Map<Id, String>();
863+ Set<Id> accountIds = new Set<Id>();
864+ for (POS_Deployment__c deployment : deployments) {
865+ if (deployment.Account__c != null) {
866+ accountIds.add(deployment.Account__c);
867+ }
868+ }
869+ if (accountIds.isEmpty()) {
870+ return routeNameByAccountId;
871+ }
872+
873+ List<Account_Route__c> accountRoutes = (List<Account_Route__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
874+ new List<String>{ 'Customer__c', 'Route__r.Name' },
875+ 'Account_Route__c'
876+ )
877+ .filters(new List<String>{ 'Customer__c IN :accountIds', 'Is_Active_Route__c = TRUE' })
878+ .build()
879+ .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'accountIds' => accountIds });
880+ for (Account_Route__c accountRoute : accountRoutes) {
881+ if (
882+ !routeNameByAccountId.containsKey(accountRoute.Customer__c) &&
883+ accountRoute.Route__r != null
884+ ) {
885+ routeNameByAccountId.put(accountRoute.Customer__c, accountRoute.Route__r.Name);
886+ }
887+ }
888+ return routeNameByAccountId;
889+ }
890+
891+ // ── 8. getRoiAnalysis ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
892+
893+ /** Default weeks compared before/after a deployment when the caller doesn't specify one. */
894+ private static final Integer ROI_DEFAULT_WINDOW_WEEKS = 4;
895+ /** Allowed range for the caller-supplied historical window, in weeks. */
896+ private static final Integer ROI_MIN_WINDOW_WEEKS = 1;
897+ private static final Integer ROI_MAX_WINDOW_WEEKS = 12;
898+ /** Hard cap on accounts scanned per side (treatment/control) to keep the invoice scan bounded. */
899+ private static final Integer ROI_MAX_ACCOUNTS = 500;
900+
901+ /**
902+ * @description Compares average weekly case-equivalent volume N weeks before vs. N weeks after
903+ * deployment for accounts that received a Deployed POS placement in the campaign
904+ * (treatment) against accounts in the same territory that did not (control),
905+ * using Invoice__c.Total_Case_Equivalents__c (the header-level rollup of case
906+ * equivalents ordered) joined via Customer__c / Invoice_Date__c. Control accounts
907+ * have no deployment date of their own, so they are compared against the average
908+ * deployment date of the treatment group in the same scope — the closest available
909+ * proxy for "what would have happened at the same point in time".
910+ * Campaign-level lift is a difference-in-differences: the treatment group's own
911+ * pre→post % change minus the control group's pre→post % change, isolating the
912+ * campaign's effect from a territory-wide trend both groups would see anyway.
913+ * @param requestJson `{ campaignId, territoryId, windowWeeks }` (a `materialType` key may also
914+ * be present — the dashboard LWC reuses one shared filter builder for both endpoints;
915+ * unused here). `windowWeeks` is optional, defaults to 4, and is clamped to [1, 12] —
916+ * it lets the caller widen or narrow the historical comparison range.
917+ * @return RoiAnalysisDTO campaign-level averages and per-account lift rows.
918+ */
919+ @AuraEnabled
920+ public static RoiAnalysisDTO getRoiAnalysis(String requestJson) {
921+ try {
922+ Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(
923+ requestJson,
924+ 'POSDeploymentController.getRoiAnalysis'
925+ );
926+ Id campaignId = (Id) req.get('campaignId');
927+ Id territoryId = (Id) req.get('territoryId');
928+ Integer windowWeeks = ROI_DEFAULT_WINDOW_WEEKS;
929+ if (req.get('windowWeeks') != null) {
930+ windowWeeks = Integer.valueOf(String.valueOf(req.get('windowWeeks')));
931+ }
932+ windowWeeks = Math.max(
933+ ROI_MIN_WINDOW_WEEKS,
934+ Math.min(ROI_MAX_WINDOW_WEEKS, windowWeeks)
935+ );
936+ Integer windowDays = windowWeeks * 7;
937+ RoiAnalysisDTO result = new RoiAnalysisDTO();
938+ if (campaignId == null) {
939+ return result;
940+ }
941+
942+ // Treatment group: accounts with a Deployed placement in this campaign (+ optional
943+ // territory scope), each keyed to its own deployment date.
944+ List<String> treatmentFilters = new List<String>{
945+ 'POS_Campaign__c = :campaignId',
946+ 'Status__c = :deployedStatus',
947+ 'Deployed_Date__c != null'
948+ };
949+ Map<String, Object> treatmentBinds = new Map<String, Object>{
950+ 'campaignId' => campaignId,
951+ 'deployedStatus' => STATUS_DEPLOYED
952+ };
953+ if (territoryId != null) {
954+ treatmentFilters.add('Account__r.Territory__c = :territoryId');
955+ treatmentBinds.put('territoryId', territoryId);
956+ }
957+ List<POS_Deployment__c> treatmentDeployments = (List<POS_Deployment__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
958+ new List<String>{ 'Account__c', 'Account__r.Territory__c', 'Deployed_Date__c' },
959+ 'POS_Deployment__c'
960+ )
961+ .filters(treatmentFilters)
962+ .limitAmount(ROI_MAX_ACCOUNTS)
963+ .build()
964+ .execute(treatmentBinds);
965+
966+ if (treatmentDeployments.isEmpty()) {
967+ return result;
968+ }
969+
970+ Map<Id, Date> deployedDateByAccount = new Map<Id, Date>();
971+ Set<Id> territoryScope = new Set<Id>();
972+ for (POS_Deployment__c d : treatmentDeployments) {
973+ // First deployment date wins per account when there are duplicates.
974+ if (
975+ !deployedDateByAccount.containsKey(d.Account__c) && d.Deployed_Date__c != null
976+ ) {
977+ deployedDateByAccount.put(d.Account__c, d.Deployed_Date__c.date());
978+ }
979+ if (d.Account__r != null && d.Account__r.Territory__c != null) {
980+ territoryScope.add(d.Account__r.Territory__c);
981+ }
982+ }
983+ Set<Id> treatmentAccountIds = deployedDateByAccount.keySet();
984+
985+ // Reference date for control accounts: the average treatment deployment date.
986+ Date referenceDate = averageDate(deployedDateByAccount.values());
987+
988+ // Control group: accounts in the same territory scope without a Deployed placement in
989+ // this campaign.
990+ Set<Id> controlAccountIds = new Set<Id>();
991+ Map<Id, String> accountNames = new Map<Id, String>();
992+ if (!territoryScope.isEmpty()) {
993+ List<Account> territoryAccounts = (List<Account>) QueryService.newBuilder(
994+ new List<String>{ 'Id', 'Name' },
995+ 'Account'
996+ )
997+ .filters(
998+ new List<String>{
999+ 'Territory__c IN :territoryScope',
1000+ 'Id NOT IN :treatmentAccountIds'
1001+ }
1002+ )
1003+ .limitAmount(ROI_MAX_ACCOUNTS)
1004+ .build()
1005+ .execute(
1006+ new Map<String, Object>{
1007+ 'territoryScope' => territoryScope,
1008+ 'treatmentAccountIds' => treatmentAccountIds
1009+ }
1010+ );
1011+ for (Account a : territoryAccounts) {
1012+ controlAccountIds.add(a.Id);
1013+ accountNames.put(a.Id, a.Name);
1014+ }
1015+ }
1016+
1017+ Set<Id> allAccountIds = new Set<Id>(treatmentAccountIds);
1018+ allAccountIds.addAll(controlAccountIds);
1019+ if (allAccountIds.isEmpty()) {
1020+ return result;
1021+ }
1022+
1023+ // Treatment account names — control names were captured above from the territory query.
1024+ List<Account> treatmentAccounts = (List<Account>) QueryService.newBuilder(
1025+ new List<String>{ 'Id', 'Name' },
1026+ 'Account'
1027+ )
1028+ .filters(new List<String>{ 'Id IN :treatmentAccountIds' })
1029+ .build()
1030+ .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'treatmentAccountIds' => treatmentAccountIds });
1031+ for (Account a : treatmentAccounts) {
1032+ accountNames.put(a.Id, a.Name);
1033+ }
1034+
1035+ // Bound the invoice scan to the widest possible before/after window across all accounts.
1036+ Date earliestStart = referenceDate.addDays(-windowDays);
1037+ Date latestEnd = referenceDate.addDays(windowDays);
1038+ for (Date d : deployedDateByAccount.values()) {
1039+ if (d.addDays(-windowDays) < earliestStart) {
1040+ earliestStart = d.addDays(-windowDays);
1041+ }
1042+ if (d.addDays(windowDays) > latestEnd) {
1043+ latestEnd = d.addDays(windowDays);
1044+ }
1045+ }
1046+
1047+ List<Invoice__c> invoices = (List<Invoice__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
1048+ new List<String>{
1049+ 'Customer__c',
1050+ 'Invoice_Date__c',
1051+ 'Total_Case_Equivalents__c'
1052+ },
1053+ 'Invoice__c'
1054+ )
1055+ .filters(
1056+ new List<String>{
1057+ 'Customer__c IN :allAccountIds',
1058+ 'Invoice_Date__c >= :earliestStart',
1059+ 'Invoice_Date__c <= :latestEnd'
1060+ }
1061+ )
1062+ .build()
1063+ .execute(
1064+ new Map<String, Object>{
1065+ 'allAccountIds' => allAccountIds,
1066+ 'earliestStart' => earliestStart,
1067+ 'latestEnd' => latestEnd
1068+ }
1069+ );
1070+
1071+ Map<Id, Decimal> beforeByAccount = new Map<Id, Decimal>();
1072+ Map<Id, Decimal> afterByAccount = new Map<Id, Decimal>();
1073+ for (Invoice__c inv : invoices) {
1074+ Date anchor = deployedDateByAccount.containsKey(inv.Customer__c)
1075+ ? deployedDateByAccount.get(inv.Customer__c)
1076+ : referenceDate;
1077+ Decimal caseEq = inv.Total_Case_Equivalents__c == null
1078+ ? 0
1079+ : inv.Total_Case_Equivalents__c;
1080+ if (
1081+ inv.Invoice_Date__c < anchor &&
1082+ inv.Invoice_Date__c >= anchor.addDays(-windowDays)
1083+ ) {
1084+ beforeByAccount.put(
1085+ inv.Customer__c,
1086+ (beforeByAccount.containsKey(inv.Customer__c)
1087+ ? beforeByAccount.get(inv.Customer__c)
1088+ : 0) + caseEq
1089+ );
1090+ } else if (
1091+ inv.Invoice_Date__c >= anchor &&
1092+ inv.Invoice_Date__c <= anchor.addDays(windowDays)
1093+ ) {
1094+ afterByAccount.put(
1095+ inv.Customer__c,
1096+ (afterByAccount.containsKey(inv.Customer__c)
1097+ ? afterByAccount.get(inv.Customer__c)
1098+ : 0) + caseEq
1099+ );
1100+ }
1101+ }
1102+
1103+ Decimal treatmentPreSum = 0;
1104+ Decimal treatmentPostSum = 0;
1105+ Integer treatmentCount = 0;
1106+ for (Id accountId : treatmentAccountIds) {
1107+ Decimal before = beforeByAccount.containsKey(accountId)
1108+ ? beforeByAccount.get(accountId)
1109+ : 0;
1110+ Decimal after = afterByAccount.containsKey(accountId)
1111+ ? afterByAccount.get(accountId)
1112+ : 0;
1113+ Decimal beforeWeekly = (before / windowWeeks).setScale(2);
1114+ Decimal afterWeekly = (after / windowWeeks).setScale(2);
1115+ Decimal liftPercent = beforeWeekly > 0
1116+ ? (((afterWeekly - beforeWeekly) / beforeWeekly) * 100).setScale(2)
1117+ : (afterWeekly > 0 ? 100 : 0);
1118+
1119+ AccountLiftDTO liftDto = new AccountLiftDTO();
1120+ liftDto.accountId = accountId;
1121+ liftDto.accountName = accountNames.get(accountId);
1122+ liftDto.isControl = false;
1123+ liftDto.prePeriodAvg = beforeWeekly;
1124+ liftDto.postPeriodAvg = afterWeekly;
1125+ liftDto.liftPct = liftPercent;
1126+ result.accounts.add(liftDto);
1127+ treatmentPreSum += beforeWeekly;
1128+ treatmentPostSum += afterWeekly;
1129+ treatmentCount++;
1130+ }
1131+
1132+ Decimal controlPreSum = 0;
1133+ Decimal controlPostSum = 0;
1134+ Integer controlCount = 0;
1135+ for (Id accountId : controlAccountIds) {
1136+ Decimal before = beforeByAccount.containsKey(accountId)
1137+ ? beforeByAccount.get(accountId)
1138+ : 0;
1139+ Decimal after = afterByAccount.containsKey(accountId)
1140+ ? afterByAccount.get(accountId)
1141+ : 0;
1142+ Decimal beforeWeekly = (before / windowWeeks).setScale(2);
1143+ Decimal afterWeekly = (after / windowWeeks).setScale(2);
1144+ Decimal liftPercent = beforeWeekly > 0
1145+ ? (((afterWeekly - beforeWeekly) / beforeWeekly) * 100).setScale(2)
1146+ : (afterWeekly > 0 ? 100 : 0);
1147+
1148+ AccountLiftDTO liftDto = new AccountLiftDTO();
1149+ liftDto.accountId = accountId;
1150+ liftDto.accountName = accountNames.get(accountId);
1151+ liftDto.isControl = true;
1152+ liftDto.prePeriodAvg = beforeWeekly;
1153+ liftDto.postPeriodAvg = afterWeekly;
1154+ liftDto.liftPct = liftPercent;
1155+ result.accounts.add(liftDto);
1156+ controlPreSum += beforeWeekly;
1157+ controlPostSum += afterWeekly;
1158+ controlCount++;
1159+ }
1160+
1161+ result.deployedAvgPre = treatmentCount > 0
1162+ ? (treatmentPreSum / treatmentCount).setScale(2)
1163+ : 0;
1164+ result.deployedAvgPost = treatmentCount > 0
1165+ ? (treatmentPostSum / treatmentCount).setScale(2)
1166+ : 0;
1167+ result.controlAvgPre = controlCount > 0
1168+ ? (controlPreSum / controlCount).setScale(2)
1169+ : 0;
1170+ result.controlAvgPost = controlCount > 0
1171+ ? (controlPostSum / controlCount).setScale(2)
1172+ : 0;
1173+
1174+ // Campaign-level lift: treatment's pre->post % change minus control's pre->post %
1175+ // change — the difference-in-differences that isolates the campaign's effect from a
1176+ // territory-wide trend both groups would have seen anyway.
1177+ Decimal treatmentPctChange = result.deployedAvgPre > 0
1178+ ? (((result.deployedAvgPost - result.deployedAvgPre) / result.deployedAvgPre) * 100)
1179+ : (result.deployedAvgPost > 0 ? 100 : 0);
1180+ Decimal controlPctChange = result.controlAvgPre > 0
1181+ ? (((result.controlAvgPost - result.controlAvgPre) / result.controlAvgPre) * 100)
1182+ : (result.controlAvgPost > 0 ? 100 : 0);
1183+ result.campaignLiftPct = (treatmentPctChange - controlPctChange).setScale(2);
1184+ return result;
1185+ } catch (Exception e) {
1186+ throw auraError('POSDeploymentController.getRoiAnalysis', e);
1187+ }
1188+ }

1190+ /** Midpoint date across a set of dates (integer day average, rounded). */
1191+ private static Date averageDate(List<Date> dates) {
1192+ if (dates == null || dates.isEmpty()) {
1193+ return Date.today();
1194+ }
1195+ Date epoch = Date.newInstance(1970, 1, 1);
1196+ Long total = 0;
1197+ for (Date d : dates) {
1198+ total += epoch.daysBetween(d);
1199+ }
1200+ Integer avgDays = (Integer) (total / dates.size());
1201+ return epoch.addDays(avgDays);
1202+ }

1204+ // ── 9. linkTransferToDeployments ──────────────────────────────────────────
1205+
1206+ /**
1207+ * @description Stamps a Transfer__c lookup onto a set of POS_Deployment__c rows, linking the
1208+ * physical material movement to the deployment assignments it fulfilled.
1209+ * @param requestJson `{ transferId, deploymentIds: [] }`.
1210+ * @return the number of POS_Deployment__c rows updated.
1211+ */
1212+ @AuraEnabled
1213+ public static Integer linkTransferToDeployments(String requestJson) {
1214+ try {
1215+ Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(
1216+ requestJson,
1217+ 'POSDeploymentController.linkTransferToDeployments'
1218+ );
1219+ Id transferId = (Id) req.get('transferId');
1220+ if (transferId == null) {
1221+ throw new POSDeploymentException(
1222+ U_ParseErrorMessage.wrapErrorMessage(
1223+ 'A transfer is required to link deployment assignments.'
1224+ )
1225+ );
1226+ }
1227+
1228+ List<Id> deploymentIds = new List<Id>();
1229+ Object rawIds = req.get('deploymentIds');
1230+ if (rawIds != null) {
1231+ for (Object rawId : (List<Object>) rawIds) {
1232+ if (rawId != null) {
1233+ deploymentIds.add((Id) rawId);
1234+ }
1235+ }
1236+ }
1237+ if (deploymentIds.isEmpty()) {
1238+ return 0;
1239+ }
1240+
1241+ // Confirm the transfer exists before stamping it onto anything.
1242+ List<Transfer__c> transfers = (List<Transfer__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
1243+ new List<String>{ 'Id' },
1244+ 'Transfer__c'
1245+ )
1246+ .filters(new List<String>{ 'Id = :transferId' })
1247+ .build()
1248+ .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'transferId' => transferId });
1249+ if (transfers.isEmpty()) {
1250+ throw new POSDeploymentException(
1251+ U_ParseErrorMessage.wrapErrorMessage(
1252+ 'The selected transfer could not be found.'
1253+ )
1254+ );
1255+ }
1256+
1257+ List<POS_Deployment__c> updates = new List<POS_Deployment__c>();
1258+ for (Id deploymentId : deploymentIds) {
1259+ updates.add(new POS_Deployment__c(Id = deploymentId, Transfer__c = transferId));
1260+ }
1261+ DmlService.doUpdate(updates, true);
1262+ return updates.size();
1263+ } catch (Exception e) {
1264+ throw auraError('POSDeploymentController.linkTransferToDeployments', e);
1265+ }
1266+ }

1269+
1270+ /** Parses a JSON object payload into a Map, logging and rethrowing a friendly error on failure. */
1271+ private static Map<String, Object> parseJsonObject(String jsonPayload, String context) {
1272+ if (String.isBlank(jsonPayload)) {
1273+ return new Map<String, Object>();
1274+ }
1275+ try {
1276+ // The parameter must not be named 'json' — Apex identifiers are case-insensitive, so it
1277+ // would shadow the JSON system class and break JSON.deserializeUntyped resolution.
1278+ return (Map<String, Object>) JSON.deserializeUntyped(jsonPayload);
1279+ } catch (Exception e) {
1280+ Logger.getInstance().error(context + ' parse', e);
1281+ Logger.getInstance().flush();
1282+ throw new POSDeploymentException(
1283+ U_ParseErrorMessage.wrapErrorMessage('The request could not be read.')
1284+ );
1285+ }
1286+ }
1287+
1288+ private static Decimal toDecimal(Object raw) {
1289+ if (raw == null) {
1290+ return null;
1291+ }
1292+ try {
1293+ return Decimal.valueOf(String.valueOf(raw));
1294+ } catch (Exception e) {
1295+ Logger.getInstance().error('POSDeploymentController.toDecimal', e);
1296+ Logger.getInstance().flush();
1297+ return null;
1298+ }
1299+ }
1300+
1301+ private static Date toDate(Object raw) {
1302+ if (raw == null) {
1303+ return null;
1304+ }
1305+ try {
1306+ return (Date) JSON.deserialize('"' + String.valueOf(raw) + '"', Date.class);
1307+ } catch (Exception e) {
1308+ Logger.getInstance().error('POSDeploymentController.toDate', e);
1309+ Logger.getInstance().flush();
1310+ return null;
1311+ }
1312+ }

100+ Test.startTest();
101+ List<POS_Campaign__c> campaigns = POSDeploymentController.getCampaigns();

1+import { createOfflineQueue, isNetworkError } from "../offlineQueue";
2+
3+function setOnline(value) {
4+ Object.defineProperty(window.navigator, "onLine", { value, configurable: true });
5+}
6+
7+function makeQueue() {
8+ return createOfflineQueue({
9+ storageKey: "offlineQueue.test",
10+ itemsKey: "items",
11+ idFor: (items, batches) => `${batches.length}-${items.length}`,
12+ });
13+}
14+
15+describe("offlineQueue core", () => {
16+ afterEach(() => {
17+ makeQueue().clear();
18+ jest.restoreAllMocks();
19+ setOnline(true);
20+ });
21+
22+ it("starts empty", () => {
23+ expect(makeQueue().getPending()).toEqual([]);
24+ });
25+
26+ it("persists an enqueued batch under the caller-supplied itemsKey", () => {
27+ const queue = makeQueue();
28+ const id = queue.enqueue([{ id: "a" }]);
29+ expect(id).not.toBeNull();
30+ expect(queue.getPending()).toEqual([{ id, items: [{ id: "a" }], attempts: 0 }]);
31+ });
32+
33+ it("returns null (not a false success) when localStorage.setItem throws", () => {
34+ jest.spyOn(window.Storage.prototype, "setItem").mockImplementation(() => {
35+ throw new Error("QuotaExceededError");
36+ });
37+ expect(makeQueue().enqueue([{ id: "a" }])).toBeNull();
38+ });
39+
40+ it("drain does nothing while offline", async () => {
41+ const queue = makeQueue();
42+ queue.enqueue([{ id: "a" }]);
43+ setOnline(false);
44+ const syncFn = jest.fn();
45+ const onBatchSynced = jest.fn();
46+ const result = await queue.drain(syncFn, onBatchSynced);
47+ expect(syncFn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
48+ expect(onBatchSynced).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
49+ expect(result).toEqual({ failed: null });
50+ expect(queue.getPending()).toHaveLength(1);
51+ });
52+
53+ it("drains a successful batch, removes it, and invokes onBatchSynced with the result", async () => {
54+ const queue = makeQueue();
55+ queue.enqueue([{ id: "a" }, { id: "b" }]);
56+ const syncFn = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue("ok");
57+ const onBatchSynced = jest.fn();
58+ const result = await queue.drain(syncFn, onBatchSynced);
59+ expect(syncFn).toHaveBeenCalledWith([{ id: "a" }, { id: "b" }]);
60+ expect(onBatchSynced).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
61+ "ok",
62+ expect.objectContaining({ items: [{ id: "a" }, { id: "b" }] })
63+ );
64+ expect(result.failed).toBeNull();
65+ expect(queue.getPending()).toHaveLength(0);
66+ });
67+
68+ it("keeps a transiently-failing batch queued (ordering preserved) under MAX_ATTEMPTS", async () => {
69+ const queue = makeQueue();
70+ queue.enqueue([{ id: "a" }]);
71+ const syncFn = jest.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error("temporary"));
72+ await queue.drain(syncFn);
73+ expect(queue.getPending()).toHaveLength(1);
74+ expect(queue.getPending()[0].attempts).toBe(1);
75+ });
76+
77+ it("drops a poison batch after MAX_ATTEMPTS and surfaces its error", async () => {
78+ const queue = makeQueue();
79+ queue.enqueue([{ id: "a" }]);
80+ const syncFn = jest.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error("poison"));
81+ await queue.drain(syncFn);
82+ await queue.drain(syncFn);
83+ const result = await queue.drain(syncFn);
84+ expect(result.failed).not.toBeNull();
85+ expect(result.failed.message).toBe("poison");
86+ expect(queue.getPending()).toHaveLength(0);
87+ });
88+
89+ it("isNetworkError recognizes fetch/TypeError-shaped failures and rejects real Apex errors", () => {
90+ expect(isNetworkError(new TypeError("Failed to fetch"))).toBe(true);
91+ expect(isNetworkError({ status: 0 })).toBe(true);
92+ expect(isNetworkError({ message: "Network request failed" })).toBe(true);
93+ expect(isNetworkError({ body: { message: "FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION" } })).toBe(
94+ false
95+ );
96+ expect(isNetworkError(null)).toBe(false);
97+ });
98+});
OHFY-OMS-UI/force-app/main/default/lwc/offlineQueue/offlineQueue.js+147-0
@@ -0,0 +1,147 @@
1+/**
2+ * Shared localStorage-backed offline batch queue: persist/enqueue/drain with retry and
3+ * poison-batch handling. Extracted from near-identical implementations in
4+ * `posDeploymentQueue` (BMS-3854) and `posDeliveryQueue` (BMS-3865) — both drivers-may-be-offline
5+ * flows shared the same persist/retry/poison-batch mechanics, just with different batch shapes
6+ * and result-stat aggregation, so a bug in the retry logic had to be fixed twice (BMS-3854 code
7+ * review). Each caller supplies its own batch-item field name and id strategy; result-shape
8+ * aggregation stays in the caller, since that varies (row-level stats vs. batch counts).
9+ *
10+ * Pure JS, no LWC imports — unit-testable in isolation.
11+ */
12+
13+/** A batch that fails this many sync attempts is treated as poison (deterministic rejection). */
14+const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3;
15+
16+function store() {
17+ // globalThis.localStorage may be absent in some runtimes (SSR/tests without jsdom).
18+ return typeof globalThis !== "undefined" && globalThis.localStorage
19+ ? globalThis.localStorage
20+ : null;
21+}
22+
23+/**
24+ * Creates an offline queue instance backed by `storageKey`. `itemsKey` names the batch field
25+ * holding the queued item array (kept per-caller so each queue's persisted shape — and existing
26+ * tests — are unaffected by sharing this core). `idFor(items, existingBatches)` generates the
27+ * new batch's queue id.
28+ */
29+export function createOfflineQueue({ storageKey, itemsKey, idFor }) {
30+ function getPending() {
31+ const ls = store();
32+ if (!ls) {
33+ return [];
34+ }
35+ try {
36+ const raw = ls.getItem(storageKey);
37+ return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
38+ } catch {
39+ return [];
40+ }
41+ }
42+
43+ function save(batches) {
44+ const ls = store();
45+ if (!ls) {
46+ return false;
47+ }
48+ try {
49+ ls.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(batches));
50+ return true;
51+ } catch {
52+ // Quota / serialization failure — report it so the caller never claims a false success.
53+ return false;
54+ }
55+ }
56+
57+ function removeBatch(id) {
58+ save(getPending().filter(b => b.id !== id));
59+ }
60+
61+ function bumpAttempts(id, attempts) {
62+ save(getPending().map(b => (b.id === id ? { ...b, attempts } : b)));
63+ }
64+
65+ /** Persists a batch of items and returns its queue id, or null if persistence failed. */
66+ function enqueue(items) {
67+ const batches = getPending();
68+ const id = idFor(items, batches);
69+ batches.push({ id, [itemsKey]: items, attempts: 0 });
70+ return save(batches) ? id : null;
71+ }
72+
73+ /** True when the browser reports connectivity (defaults to online when unknown). */
74+ function isOnline() {
75+ return typeof navigator === "undefined" || navigator.onLine !== false;
76+ }
77+
78+ /**
79+ * Drains the queue: for each pending batch, calls `syncFn(batch[itemsKey])` and removes the
80+ * batch on success, invoking `onBatchSynced(result, batch)` so the caller can aggregate its
81+ * own stats. A transient failure (under MAX_ATTEMPTS) leaves the batch queued and stops so
82+ * ordering is preserved. A batch that has failed MAX_ATTEMPTS times is treated as a
83+ * deterministic/poison failure — dropped so it can't wedge the queue forever, with its error
84+ * returned as `failed`.
85+ */
86+ async function drain(syncFn, onBatchSynced) {
87+ if (!isOnline()) {
88+ return { failed: null };
89+ }
90+ let failed = null;
91+ for (const batch of getPending()) {
92+ try {
93+ // Batches must sync in order and stop at the first unresolved failure (see
94+ // doc comment above), so this await cannot be parallelized across the loop.
95+ // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
96+ const result = await syncFn(batch[itemsKey]);
97+ removeBatch(batch.id);
98+ if (onBatchSynced) {
99+ onBatchSynced(result, batch);
100+ }
101+ } catch (e) {
102+ const attempts = (batch.attempts || 0) + 1;
103+ if (attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
104+ // Poison batch — drop it and surface the real error instead of a soft retry forever.
105+ removeBatch(batch.id);
106+ failed = e;
107+ continue;
108+ }
109+ // Transient failure — record the attempt and stop so ordering is preserved.
110+ bumpAttempts(batch.id, attempts);
111+ break;
112+ }
113+ }
114+ return { failed };
115+ }
116+
117+ /** Test hook — clears the persisted queue. */
118+ function clear() {
119+ const ls = store();
120+ if (ls) {
121+ ls.removeItem(storageKey);
122+ }
123+ }
124+
125+ return { getPending, enqueue, isOnline, drain, clear };
126+}
127+
128+/**
129+ * True when `e` looks like a transport-level failure (offline/network blip) rather than a
130+ * real server-side validation/security error. Only network-shaped errors should be queued for
131+ * offline retry — a genuine Apex error should be surfaced to the user immediately.
132+ */
133+export function isNetworkError(e) {
134+ if (!e) {
135+ return false;
136+ }
137+ const status = e.status ?? e.code;
138+ const name = e.name || "";
139+ const message = ((e.message || (e.body && e.body.message)) ?? "").toLowerCase();
140+ return (
141+ name === "TypeError" ||
142+ status === 0 ||
143+ message.includes("failed to fetch") ||
144+ message.includes("network") ||
145+ message.includes("offline")
146+ );
147+}

OHFY-OMS-UI/force-app/main/default/lwc/posDeploymentCapture/__tests__/posDeploymentQueue.test.js+167-0
@@ -0,0 +1,167 @@
1+import {
2+ getPending,
3+ enqueue,
4+ drain,
5+ isOnline,
6+ isNetworkError,
7+ __clear,
8+} from "../posDeploymentQueue";
9+
10+function setOnline(value) {
11+ Object.defineProperty(window.navigator, "onLine", { value, configurable: true });
12+}
13+
14+describe("posDeploymentQueue", () => {
15+ afterEach(() => {
16+ __clear();
17+ jest.restoreAllMocks();
18+ setOnline(true);
19+ });
20+
21+ it("starts empty", () => {
22+ expect(getPending()).toEqual([]);
23+ });
24+
25+ it("persists an enqueued payload and returns a queue id", () => {
26+ const id = enqueue([{ deploymentId: "d1", status: "Deployed" }]);
27+ expect(id).not.toBeNull();
28+ expect(getPending()).toHaveLength(1);
29+ expect(getPending()[0].payload[0].deploymentId).toBe("d1");
30+ });
31+
32+ it("returns null (not a false success) when localStorage.setItem throws", () => {
33+ jest.spyOn(window.Storage.prototype, "setItem").mockImplementation(() => {
34+ throw new Error("QuotaExceededError");
35+ });
36+ const id = enqueue([{ deploymentId: "d1", status: "Deployed" }]);
37+ expect(id).toBeNull();
38+ });
39+
40+ it("isOnline reflects navigator.onLine", () => {
41+ setOnline(false);
42+ expect(isOnline()).toBe(false);
43+ setOnline(true);
44+ expect(isOnline()).toBe(true);
45+ });
46+
47+ it("isNetworkError recognizes fetch/TypeError-shaped failures and rejects real Apex errors", () => {
48+ expect(isNetworkError(new TypeError("Failed to fetch"))).toBe(true);
49+ expect(isNetworkError({ status: 0 })).toBe(true);
50+ expect(isNetworkError({ message: "Network request failed" })).toBe(true);
51+ expect(isNetworkError({ body: { message: "FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION" } })).toBe(
52+ false
53+ );
54+ expect(isNetworkError(null)).toBe(false);
55+ });
56+
57+ it("drain does nothing while offline", async () => {
58+ enqueue([{ deploymentId: "d1", status: "Deployed" }]);
59+ setOnline(false);
60+ const syncFn = jest.fn();
61+ const result = await drain(syncFn);
62+ expect(syncFn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
63+ expect(result).toEqual({
64+ syncedCount: 0,
65+ totalCount: 0,
66+ failed: null,
67+ conflicts: [],
68+ failedRows: [],
69+ failedCount: 0,
70+ });
71+ expect(getPending()).toHaveLength(1);
72+ });
73+
74+ it("drains a successful batch and reports syncedCount/totalCount", async () => {
75+ enqueue([
76+ { deploymentId: "d1", status: "Deployed" },
77+ { deploymentId: "d2", status: "Deferred" },
78+ ]);
79+ const syncFn = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue([
80+ { deploymentId: "d1", success: true, conflict: false },
81+ { deploymentId: "d2", success: true, conflict: false },
82+ ]);
83+ const result = await drain(syncFn);
84+ expect(result.syncedCount).toBe(2);
85+ expect(result.totalCount).toBe(2);
86+ expect(result.failed).toBeNull();
87+ expect(result.conflicts).toEqual([]);
88+ expect(getPending()).toHaveLength(0);
89+ });
90+
91+ it("surfaces conflict rows from a successfully-synced batch", async () => {
92+ enqueue([{ deploymentId: "d1", status: "Deployed" }]);
93+ const syncFn = jest
94+ .fn()
95+ .mockResolvedValue([{ deploymentId: "d1", success: true, conflict: true }]);
96+ const result = await drain(syncFn);
97+ expect(result.conflicts).toEqual([{ deploymentId: "d1", success: true, conflict: true }]);
98+ expect(getPending()).toHaveLength(0);
99+ });
100+
101+ it("keeps a transiently-failing batch queued (ordering preserved) under MAX_ATTEMPTS", async () => {
102+ enqueue([{ deploymentId: "d1", status: "Deployed" }]);
103+ const syncFn = jest.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error("temporary"));
104+ await drain(syncFn);
105+ expect(getPending()).toHaveLength(1);
106+ expect(getPending()[0].attempts).toBe(1);
107+ });
108+
109+ it("drops a poison batch after MAX_ATTEMPTS and surfaces its error", async () => {
110+ enqueue([{ deploymentId: "d1", status: "Deployed" }]);
111+ const syncFn = jest.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error("poison"));
112+ await drain(syncFn);
113+ await drain(syncFn);
114+ const result = await drain(syncFn);
115+ expect(result.failed).not.toBeNull();
116+ expect(result.failed.message).toBe("poison");
117+ expect(getPending()).toHaveLength(0);
118+ });
119+
120+ it("surfaces per-row save failures from a synced batch without re-queuing them", async () => {
121+ enqueue([
122+ { deploymentId: "d1", status: "Deployed" },
123+ { deploymentId: "d2", status: "Not Deployed" },
124+ ]);
125+ const syncFn = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue([
126+ { deploymentId: "d1", success: true, conflict: false },
127+ { deploymentId: "d2", success: false, conflict: false },
128+ ]);
129+ const result = await drain(syncFn);
130+
131+ expect(result.syncedCount).toBe(2);
132+ expect(result.totalCount).toBe(2);
133+ expect(result.failedCount).toBe(1);
134+ expect(result.failedRows).toEqual([
135+ { deploymentId: "d2", success: false, conflict: false },
136+ ]);
137+ // The batch as a whole synced (server accepted the call); the failed row isn't
138+ // re-queued — a validation failure would loop forever, surfacing is the goal.
139+ expect(getPending()).toHaveLength(0);
140+ });
141+
142+ it("does not double-count a conflict row as a failed row", async () => {
143+ enqueue([{ deploymentId: "d1", status: "Deployed" }]);
144+ const syncFn = jest
145+ .fn()
146+ .mockResolvedValue([{ deploymentId: "d1", success: false, conflict: true }]);
147+ const result = await drain(syncFn);
148+
149+ expect(result.conflicts).toEqual([{ deploymentId: "d1", success: false, conflict: true }]);
150+ expect(result.failedRows).toEqual([]);
151+ expect(result.failedCount).toBe(0);
152+ });
153+
154+ it("counts syncedCount from the server's results, not the submitted payload length, when the server deduped a repeated deploymentId", async () => {
155+ enqueue([
156+ { deploymentId: "d1", status: "Deployed" },
157+ { deploymentId: "d1", status: "Deployed" },
158+ ]);
159+ const syncFn = jest
160+ .fn()
161+ .mockResolvedValue([{ deploymentId: "d1", success: true, conflict: false }]);
162+ const result = await drain(syncFn);
163+
164+ expect(result.totalCount).toBe(2);
165+ expect(result.syncedCount).toBe(1);
166+ });
167+});
