1+import { LightningElement, api, track } from "lwc";
2+import { ShowToastEvent } from "lightning/platformShowToastEvent";
3+import { loadStyle } from "lightning/platformResourceLoader";
4+import { getLocationService } from "lightning/mobileCapabilities";
5+import FORM_FACTOR from "@salesforce/client/formFactor";
6+import tailwindCSS from "@salesforce/resourceUrl/tailwindCSS_oms";
7+
8+import getDeploymentsForAccount from "@salesforce/apex/POSDeploymentController.getDeploymentsForAccount";
9+import recordDeploymentStatuses from "@salesforce/apex/POSDeploymentController.recordDeploymentStatuses";
10+import { enqueue, drain, isOnline, isNetworkError, getPending } from "./posDeploymentQueue";
11+
12+/**
13+ * Driver-facing POS deployment capture (BMS-3854).
14+ *
15+ * Lists the POS materials assigned to an account (merchandise, tap handles, etc.) so a driver
16+ * can mark each Deployed / Not Deployed / Deferred at the delivery stop, attach a photo, and
17+ * save. A Not Deployed pick requires a reason code. Saving stamps a client timestamp and the
18+ * device's geolocation (best-effort — a denial/timeout falls back to null coordinates rather
19+ * than blocking the save).
20+ *
21+ * Offline-capable: if the save is attempted while offline, or the Apex call rejects with a
22+ * network-shaped error, the payload is queued to localStorage (`posDeploymentQueue`) and
23+ * drained on reconnect (component connect + the browser `online` event) — so a save made
24+ * offline survives a reload and syncs later. Any `{conflict: true}` row returned by the server
25+ * (this deployment was already recorded by someone else) is surfaced with a visible badge
26+ * rather than silently accepted.
27+ */
28+const REASON_OPTIONS = ["Account Refused", "No Space", "Material Damaged", "Other"];
29+const GEOLOCATION_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000;
30+
31+export default class PosDeploymentCapture extends LightningElement {
32+ // Account record page auto-populates recordId; accountId is an explicit override (e.g.
33+ // when embedded at a delivery stop rather than on the Account page itself).
34+ @api recordId;
35+ @api accountId;
36+ @api embedded = false;
37+
38+ @track deployments = [];
39+ @track conflictIds = [];
40+ @track failedIds = [];
41+ pendingSync = 0;
42+ loading = false;
43+ saving = false;
44+ loadError;
45+
46+ _onlineHandler;
47+ locationService;
48+ locationServiceIsAvailable = false;
49+
50+ get showHeader() {
51+ return !this.embedded;
52+ }
53+
54+ get effectiveAccountId() {
55+ return this.accountId || this.recordId || null;
56+ }
57+
58+ connectedCallback() {
59+ loadStyle(this, tailwindCSS);
60+ this.initializeLocationService();
61+ this._onlineHandler = () => this.flushQueue();
62+ if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
63+ window.addEventListener("online", this._onlineHandler);
64+ }
65+ this.pendingSync = getPending().length;
66+ this.flushQueue();
67+ if (this.effectiveAccountId) {
68+ this.loadDeployments();
69+ }
70+ }
71+
72+ disconnectedCallback() {
73+ if (this._onlineHandler && typeof window !== "undefined") {
74+ window.removeEventListener("online", this._onlineHandler);
75+ }
76+ }
77+
78+ handleAccountSelect(event) {
79+ this.accountId = (event.detail && event.detail.selectedRecordId) || null;
80+ this.deployments = [];
81+ if (this.accountId) {
82+ this.loadDeployments();
83+ }
84+ }
85+
86+ async loadDeployments() {
87+ if (!this.effectiveAccountId) {
88+ return;
89+ }
90+ this.loading = true;
91+ try {
92+ const result = await getDeploymentsForAccount({ accountId: this.effectiveAccountId });
93+ this.deployments = (result || []).map(dto => this.toRow(dto));
94+ this.loadError = undefined;
95+ } catch (e) {
96+ this.loadError = this.errorText(e);
97+ this.toast("error", "Couldn't load POS deployments", this.loadError);
98+ } finally {
99+ this.loading = false;
100+ }
101+ }
102+
103+ toRow(dto) {
104+ const status = dto.status || null;
105+ return {
106+ id: dto.id,
107+ itemName: dto.itemName,
108+ itemType: dto.itemType,
109+ quantity: dto.quantity,
110+ placementInstructions: dto.placementInstructions,
111+ campaignName: dto.campaignName,
112+ status,
113+ // Tracks the server-known status so an unchanged row isn't resubmitted.
114+ originalStatus: status,
115+ reasonCode: "",
116+ hasPhoto: false,
117+ reasonOptions: this.buildReasonOptions(""),
118+ };
119+ }
120+
121+ buildReasonOptions(selected) {
122+ return REASON_OPTIONS.map(value => ({
123+ value,
124+ label: value,
125+ isSelected: value === selected,
126+ }));
127+ }
128+
129+ handleStatusClick(event) {
130+ const id = event.currentTarget.dataset.id;
131+ const status = event.currentTarget.dataset.status;
132+ this.deployments = this.deployments.map(d => {
133+ if (d.id !== id) {
134+ return d;
135+ }
136+ const reasonCode = status === "Not Deployed" ? d.reasonCode : "";
137+ return {
138+ ...d,
139+ status,
140+ reasonCode,
141+ reasonOptions: this.buildReasonOptions(reasonCode),
142+ };
143+ });
144+ }
145+
146+ handleReasonChange(event) {
147+ const id = event.currentTarget.dataset.id;
148+ const reasonCode = event.target.value;
149+ this.deployments = this.deployments.map(d => {
150+ return d.id === id
151+ ? { ...d, reasonCode, reasonOptions: this.buildReasonOptions(reasonCode) }
152+ : d;
153+ });
154+ }
155+
156+ handleUploadFinished(event) {
157+ const id = event.currentTarget.dataset.id;
158+ const files = (event.detail && event.detail.files) || [];
159+ if (files.length === 0) {
160+ return;
161+ }
162+ this.deployments = this.deployments.map(d => (d.id === id ? { ...d, hasPhoto: true } : d));
163+ }
164+
165+ // ---- getters ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
166+
167+ get hasDeployments() {
168+ return this.deployments.length > 0;
169+ }
170+
171+ get noAccount() {
172+ return !this.effectiveAccountId;
173+ }
174+
175+ get showEmpty() {
176+ return !!this.effectiveAccountId && !this.loading && this.deployments.length === 0;
177+ }
178+
179+ get dirtyDeployments() {
180+ return this.deployments.filter(d => d.status && d.status !== d.originalStatus);
181+ }
182+
183+ get saveDisabled() {
184+ if (this.saving) {
185+ return true;
186+ }
187+ const dirty = this.dirtyDeployments;
188+ if (dirty.length === 0) {
189+ return true;
190+ }
191+ return dirty.some(d => d.status === "Not Deployed" && !d.reasonCode);
192+ }
193+
194+ get hasPendingSync() {
195+ return this.pendingSync > 0;
196+ }
197+
198+ get deploymentsView() {
199+ return this.deployments.map(d => ({
200+ ...d,
201+ showReason: d.status === "Not Deployed",
202+ isConflict: this.conflictIds.includes(d.id),
203+ isFailed: this.failedIds.includes(d.id),
204+ deployedBtnStyle: this.actionBtnStyle(d.status === "Deployed"),
205+ notDeployedBtnStyle: this.actionBtnStyle(d.status === "Not Deployed"),
206+ deferredBtnStyle: this.actionBtnStyle(d.status === "Deferred"),
207+ metaLine: `${d.itemType || "Item"} · ${d.quantity != null ? d.quantity : 0} unit(s)${
208+ d.campaignName ? ` · ${d.campaignName}` : ""
209+ }`,
210+ }));
211+ }
212+
213+ actionBtnStyle(selected) {
214+ const base =
215+ "flex: 1; padding: 8px 6px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; text-align: center; min-height: 40px;";
216+ return selected
217+ ? `${base} background: rgb(var(--ohfy-accent, 228 242 35)); color: rgb(var(--ohfy-primary, 0 0 0)); border: 1px solid rgb(var(--ohfy-primary, 0 0 0));`
218+ : `${base} background: rgb(var(--ohfy-surface, 255 255 255)); color: rgb(var(--ohfy-text-muted, 84 84 84)); border: 1px solid rgb(var(--ohfy-border, 177 199 235));`;
219+ }
220+
221+ // ---- save --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
222+
223+ /**
224+ * Initializes the mobile location service (Mobile Publisher / Salesforce mobile app) for
225+ * Small/Medium form factors — mirrors driverHomePage's initializeLocationService pattern.
226+ * Desktop form factors and any device without the capability fall back to
227+ * `navigator.geolocation` in `getCoords`.
228+ */
229+ initializeLocationService() {
230+ const isMobile = FORM_FACTOR === "Small" || FORM_FACTOR === "Medium";
231+ if (isMobile) {
232+ this.locationService = getLocationService();
233+ this.locationServiceIsAvailable =
234+ !!this.locationService && this.locationService.isAvailable();
235+ }
236+ }
237+
238+ /** Best-effort geolocation via the mobile location service; resolves null coords on failure/absence. */
239+ async getMobileCoords() {
240+ try {
241+ const result = await this.locationService.getCurrentPosition({
242+ enableHighAccuracy: true,
243+ });
244+ return {
245+ latitude: result.coords.latitude,
246+ longitude: result.coords.longitude,
247+ };
248+ } catch (e) {
249+ return null;
250+ }
251+ }
252+
253+ /** Best-effort geolocation via the browser API — resolves { latitude: null, longitude: null } on denial/timeout/absence. */
254+ getBrowserCoords() {
255+ return new Promise(resolve => {
256+ if (typeof navigator === "undefined" || !navigator.geolocation) {
257+ resolve({ latitude: null, longitude: null });
258+ return;
259+ }
260+ navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
261+ pos =>
262+ resolve({
263+ latitude: pos.coords.latitude,
264+ longitude: pos.coords.longitude,
265+ }),
266+ () => resolve({ latitude: null, longitude: null }),
267+ { timeout: GEOLOCATION_TIMEOUT_MS }
268+ );
269+ });
270+ }
271+
272+ /**
273+ * Best-effort geolocation — resolves { latitude: null, longitude: null } on denial/timeout/
274+ * absence. Tries the mobile location service (Small/Medium form factor) first, falling back
275+ * to the browser `navigator.geolocation` API on any failure or when unavailable (desktop).
276+ */
277+ async getCoords() {
278+ if (this.locationServiceIsAvailable) {
279+ const mobileCoords = await this.getMobileCoords();
280+ if (mobileCoords) {
281+ return mobileCoords;
282+ }
283+ }
284+ return this.getBrowserCoords();
285+ }
286+
287+ async handleSave() {
288+ if (this.saveDisabled) {
289+ return;
290+ }
291+ const dirty = this.dirtyDeployments;
292+ this.saving = true;
293+ try {
294+ const coords = await this.getCoords();
295+ const clientTimestamp = new Date().toISOString();
296+ const payload = dirty.map(d => ({
297+ deploymentId: d.id,
298+ status: d.status,
299+ reasonCode: d.status === "Not Deployed" ? d.reasonCode : null,
300+ clientTimestamp,
301+ latitude: coords.latitude,
302+ longitude: coords.longitude,
303+ hasPhoto: !!d.hasPhoto,
304+ }));
305+
306+ if (!isOnline()) {
307+ this.queueOffline(payload);
308+ return;
309+ }
310+
311+ try {
312+ const results = await recordDeploymentStatuses({
313+ payloadJson: JSON.stringify(payload),
314+ });
315+ const { conflictCount, failedCount } = this.applyResults(results);
316+ if (failedCount > 0) {
317+ const conflictNote =
318+ conflictCount > 0
319+ ? ` ${conflictCount} more had a conflict — review before resubmitting.`
320+ : "";
321+ this.toast(
322+ "error",
323+ "Some deployments could not be saved",
324+ `${failedCount} of ${payload.length} deployments could not be saved — they remain unsaved below.${conflictNote}`
325+ );
326+ } else if (conflictCount > 0) {
327+ this.toast(
328+ "warning",
329+ "Saved with conflicts",
330+ `${conflictCount} of ${payload.length} deployment(s) had a conflict — review before resubmitting.`
331+ );
332+ } else {
333+ this.toast(
334+ "success",
335+ "Deployment statuses saved",
336+ `${payload.length} POS deployment(s) recorded.`
337+ );
338+ }
339+ await this.loadDeployments();
340+ } catch (e) {
341+ if (isNetworkError(e)) {
342+ this.queueOffline(payload);
343+ } else {
344+ this.toast("error", "Couldn't save deployment statuses", this.errorText(e));
345+ }
346+ }
347+ } finally {
348+ this.saving = false;
349+ }
350+ }
351+
352+ queueOffline(payload) {
353+ const queued = enqueue(payload);
354+ if (queued === null) {
355+ this.toast(
356+ "error",
357+ "Couldn't save offline",
358+ "Device storage is full — the deployment update was not saved. Free up space and try again."
359+ );
360+ return;
361+ }
362+ this.pendingSync = getPending().length;
363+ this.toast(
364+ "success",
365+ "Saved offline",
366+ `${payload.length} POS deployment(s) queued — they'll sync when you're back online.`
367+ );
368+ }
369+
370+ async flushQueue() {
371+ const { syncedCount, totalCount, failed, conflicts, failedRows, failedCount } = await drain(
372+ payload => recordDeploymentStatuses({ payloadJson: JSON.stringify(payload) })
373+ );
374+ this.pendingSync = getPending().length;
375+ if (conflicts.length > 0) {
376+ this.conflictIds = [
377+ ...new Set([...this.conflictIds, ...conflicts.map(c => c.deploymentId)]),
378+ ];
379+ }
380+ if (failedCount > 0) {
381+ this.failedIds = [
382+ ...new Set([...this.failedIds, ...failedRows.map(r => r.deploymentId)]),
383+ ];
384+ }
385+ if (failed) {
386+ this.toast("error", "A queued deployment update was rejected", this.errorText(failed));
387+ }
388+ if (totalCount > 0) {
389+ let message =
390+ failedCount > 0
391+ ? `${syncedCount} of ${totalCount} uploaded, ${failedCount} failed.`
392+ : `${syncedCount} of ${totalCount} deployments uploaded successfully.`;
393+ if (conflicts.length > 0) {
394+ message += ` ${conflicts.length} had a conflict — review before resubmitting.`;
395+ }
396+ this.toast(
397+ failedCount > 0 ? "error" : conflicts.length > 0 ? "warning" : "success",
398+ "Offline deployments uploaded",
399+ message
400+ );
401+ }
402+ if (syncedCount > 0 && this.effectiveAccountId) {
403+ this.loadDeployments();
404+ }
405+ }
406+
407+ /**
408+ * Applies `{deploymentId, success, conflict}` results, badging conflict rows and rows that
409+ * failed to save (success: false, conflict: false). Returns `{conflictCount, failedCount}`.
410+ */
411+ applyResults(results) {
412+ const conflictIds = (results || []).filter(r => r && r.conflict).map(r => r.deploymentId);
413+ const failedRowIds = (results || [])
414+ .filter(r => r && r.success === false && !r.conflict)
415+ .map(r => r.deploymentId);
416+ if (conflictIds.length > 0) {
417+ this.conflictIds = [...new Set([...this.conflictIds, ...conflictIds])];
418+ }
419+ if (failedRowIds.length > 0) {
420+ this.failedIds = [...new Set([...this.failedIds, ...failedRowIds])];
421+ }
422+ return { conflictCount: conflictIds.length, failedCount: failedRowIds.length };
423+ }
424+
425+ errorText(e) {
426+ return (e && e.body && e.body.message) || (e && e.message) || "Unexpected error.";
427+ }
428+
429+ toast(variant, title, message) {
430+ this.dispatchEvent(new ShowToastEvent({ title, message, variant }));
431+ }

@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
1+/**
2+ * Offline queue for POS deployment capture (BMS-3854).
3+ *
4+ * A driver marking POS deployments at a stop may be offline. This persists each save's
5+ * payload array to localStorage and drains it (with retry/backoff) when connectivity is
6+ * available — so a deployment update made offline survives a reload and syncs on reconnect.
7+ * Persist/retry/poison-batch mechanics live in the shared `c/offlineQueue` core (extracted
8+ * during BMS-3854 code review, alongside posDeliveryConfirm's `posDeliveryQueue`) — this module
9+ * supplies only the deployment-specific batch shape and result-stat aggregation.
10+ */
11+import { createOfflineQueue, isNetworkError as sharedIsNetworkError } from "c/offlineQueue";
12+
13+const STORAGE_KEY = "ohfyPosDeploymentQueue";
14+
15+const queue = createOfflineQueue({
16+ storageKey: STORAGE_KEY,
17+ itemsKey: "payload",
18+ idFor: (payload, batches) =>
19+ `${Date.now()}-${batches.length}-${payload.map(p => p.deploymentId).join(",")}`,
20+});
21+
22+export const getPending = queue.getPending;
23+export const enqueue = queue.enqueue;
24+export const isOnline = queue.isOnline;
25+export const __clear = queue.clear;
26+export const isNetworkError = sharedIsNetworkError;
27+
28+/**
29+ * Drains the queue and aggregates deployment-specific stats.
30+ *
31+ * Returns `{ syncedCount, totalCount, failed, conflicts, failedRows, failedCount }`:
32+ * - `totalCount` — total deployment rows across all batches pending at the start of the drain.
33+ * - `syncedCount` — deployment rows the server actually returned a result for (from
34+ * successfully-synced batches) — not the submitted payload length, which can overcount if a
35+ * batch's payload repeated a deploymentId that the server deduped.
36+ * - `failed` — the Error of a dropped poison batch, or null.
37+ * - `conflicts` — flattened `{deploymentId, success, conflict}` rows with `conflict: true` from
38+ * any successfully-synced batch.
39+ * - `failedRows` — flattened `{deploymentId, success, conflict}` rows with `success: false` and
40+ * `conflict: false` (a per-row validation rejection) from any successfully-synced batch. These
41+ * are never re-queued — a validation failure would loop forever — surfacing them is the goal.
42+ * - `failedCount` — `failedRows.length`.
43+ */
44+export async function drain(syncFn) {
45+ if (!queue.isOnline()) {
46+ return {
47+ syncedCount: 0,
48+ totalCount: 0,
49+ failed: null,
50+ conflicts: [],
51+ failedRows: [],
52+ failedCount: 0,
53+ };
54+ }
55+ const pending = queue.getPending();
56+ const totalCount = pending.reduce((sum, batch) => sum + batch.payload.length, 0);
57+ let syncedCount = 0;
58+ let conflicts = [];
59+ let failedRows = [];
60+ const { failed } = await queue.drain(syncFn, results => {
61+ // Count actual server-reported rows, not the submitted batch length — the server dedups
62+ // a payload that repeats a deploymentId, so payload.length can overcount a batch that
63+ // included a duplicate.
64+ syncedCount += (results || []).length;
65+ conflicts = conflicts.concat((results || []).filter(r => r && r.conflict));
66+ failedRows = failedRows.concat(
67+ (results || []).filter(r => r && r.success === false && !r.conflict)
68+ );
69+ });
70+ return {
71+ syncedCount,
72+ totalCount,
73+ failed,
74+ conflicts,
75+ failedRows,
76+ failedCount: failedRows.length,
77+ };
78+}

1+/* Native <select> — compact dropdowns immune to shadow-DOM stacking traps (see /ohfy-design). */
2+.dpd-select {
3+ background: rgb(var(--ohfy-surface, 255 255 255));
4+ color: rgb(var(--ohfy-primary, 0 0 0));
5+ border: 1px solid rgb(var(--ohfy-border, 177 199 235));
6+ border-radius: 8px;
7+ font-size: 12px;
8+ font-weight: 500;
9+ padding: 6px 10px;
10+ cursor: pointer;
11+ min-height: 32px;
12+}
13+
14+.dpd-select:focus {
15+ outline: none;

20+.dpd-stat-value {
21+ font-size: 22px;
22+ font-weight: 700;
23+ margin-top: 4px;
24+ color: rgb(var(--ohfy-primary, 0 0 0));
25+}

1+import { LightningElement, track } from "lwc";
2+import { loadStyle } from "lightning/platformResourceLoader";
3+import { ShowToastEvent } from "lightning/platformShowToastEvent";
4+import LightningConfirm from "lightning/confirm";
5+import tailwindCSS from "@salesforce/resourceUrl/tailwindCSS_oms";
6+
7+import getCampaigns from "@salesforce/apex/POSDeploymentController.getCampaigns";
8+import getDashboardSummary from "@salesforce/apex/POSDeploymentController.getDashboardSummary";
9+import getAccountDeploymentHistory from "@salesforce/apex/POSDeploymentController.getAccountDeploymentHistory";
10+import getComplianceReport from "@salesforce/apex/POSDeploymentController.getComplianceReport";
11+import getRoiAnalysis from "@salesforce/apex/POSDeploymentController.getRoiAnalysis";
12+
13+/**
14+ * POS Deployment Visibility management dashboard (BMS-3854).
15+ *
16+ * Marketing/management view: campaign / material-type / territory filters drive a deployment-rate
17+ * summary, stat tiles, and an account-pin map (with a color-coded legend + always-rendered pin
18+ * list, since lightning-map marker colors can't be customized). Clicking a pin or list row opens
19+ * an account's deployment history. A Compliance Report and an ROI Analysis are reachable via a
20+ * section toggle. The compliance rows can be exported as CSV.
21+ *
22+ * The CSV's Material Type column uses the per-row `materialType` supplied by
23+ * `getComplianceReport`, falling back to the selected material-type filter label (or "All")
24+ * for legacy rows without one — see `_materialTypeForExport()`.
25+ */
26+const MATERIAL_TYPE_OPTIONS = ["Merchandise", "Tap Handle"];
27+
28+const STATUS_BUCKET_META = {
29+ deployed: { label: "Deployed", color: "rgb(var(--ohfy-success, 15 110 86))" },
30+ notDeployed: { label: "Not Deployed", color: "rgb(var(--ohfy-danger, 163 45 45))" },
31+ deferred: { label: "Deferred", color: "rgb(var(--ohfy-focus-ring, 74 95 176))" },
32+ noAssignment: { label: "No Assignment", color: "rgb(var(--ohfy-border, 177 199 235))" },
33+};
34+
35+export default class PosDeploymentDashboard extends LightningElement {
36+ @track campaignOptions = [];
37+ @track territoryOptions = [];
38+ @track summary;
39+ @track complianceReport;
40+ @track roiAnalysis;
41+ @track history = [];
42+
43+ selectedCampaignId = "";
44+ selectedMaterialType = "";
45+ selectedTerritoryId = "";
46+ selectedRoiWindowWeeks = "4";
47+
48+ roiWindowOptions = [
49+ { value: "2", label: "2 weeks", isSelected: false },
50+ { value: "4", label: "4 weeks", isSelected: true },
51+ { value: "8", label: "8 weeks", isSelected: false },
52+ { value: "12", label: "12 weeks", isSelected: false },
53+ ];
54+
55+ activeSection = "overview"; // 'overview' | 'compliance' | 'roi'
56+ selectedAccountId;
57+ selectedAccountName;
58+
59+ isInitializing = true;
60+ isLoadingSummary = false;
61+ isLoadingCompliance = false;
62+ isLoadingRoi = false;
63+ isLoadingHistory = false;
64+ loadError;
65+
66+ // Monotonic load tokens: a rapid filter change starts a newer load, and an older (possibly
67+ // slower) response must not overwrite the current filter's data.
68+ _loadSeq = 0;
69+ _complianceSeq = 0;
70+ _roiSeq = 0;
71+
72+ // A filter/window change invalidates whichever of Compliance/ROI isn't the active tab (the
73+ // active one reloads immediately instead). Without this, switching campaign/material/territory
74+ // while on one tab left the other showing a stale response from a prior filter combination the
75+ // next time it was opened.
76+ _complianceStale = true;
77+ _roiStale = true;
78+
79+ materialTypeOptions = [
80+ { value: "", label: "All material types", isSelected: true },
81+ ...MATERIAL_TYPE_OPTIONS.map(v => ({ value: v, label: v, isSelected: false })),
82+ ];
83+
84+ skeletonTiles = [1, 2, 3, 4];
85+
86+ connectedCallback() {
87+ loadStyle(this, tailwindCSS);
88+ this.initialize();
89+ }
90+
91+ async initialize() {
92+ try {
93+ const campaigns = await getCampaigns();
94+ // Compliance/ROI both require one specific campaign and render an empty state
95+ // otherwise, so default to the most recent one (getCampaigns orders by start date
96+ // descending) instead of leaving the confusing "All campaigns" blank state active.
97+ const defaultCampaignId = campaigns && campaigns.length > 0 ? campaigns[0].Id : "";
98+ this.selectedCampaignId = defaultCampaignId;
99+ this.campaignOptions = [
100+ { value: "", label: "All campaigns", isSelected: defaultCampaignId === "" },
101+ ...(campaigns || []).map(c => ({
102+ value: c.Id,
103+ label: c.Name,
104+ isSelected: c.Id === defaultCampaignId,
105+ })),
106+ ];
107+ await this.loadSummary();
108+ } catch (error) {
109+ this.loadError = this.errorMessage(error);
110+ } finally {
111+ this.isInitializing = false;
112+ }
113+ }
114+
115+ buildFilters() {
116+ return {
117+ campaignId: this.selectedCampaignId || null,
118+ materialType: this.selectedMaterialType || null,
119+ territoryId: this.selectedTerritoryId || null,
120+ };
121+ }
122+
123+ async loadSummary() {
124+ const seq = ++this._loadSeq;
125+ this.isLoadingSummary = true;
126+ try {
127+ const dto = await getDashboardSummary({
128+ filtersJson: JSON.stringify(this.buildFilters()),
129+ });
130+ if (seq !== this._loadSeq) {
131+ return;
132+ }
133+ this.summary = dto;
134+ this.territoryOptions = [
135+ {
136+ value: "",
137+ label: "All territories",
138+ isSelected: this.selectedTerritoryId === "",
139+ },
140+ ...((dto && dto.territories) || []).map(t => ({
141+ value: t.territoryId,
142+ label: t.territoryName,
143+ isSelected: t.territoryId === this.selectedTerritoryId,
144+ })),
145+ ];
146+ this.loadError = undefined;
147+ } catch (error) {
148+ if (seq !== this._loadSeq) {
149+ return;
150+ }
151+ this.loadError = this.errorMessage(error);
152+ } finally {
153+ if (seq === this._loadSeq) {
154+ this.isLoadingSummary = false;
155+ }
156+ }
157+ }
158+
159+ // ---- filters ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
160+
161+ handleCampaignChange(event) {
162+ this.selectedCampaignId = event.target.value;
163+ this.campaignOptions = this.campaignOptions.map(o => ({
164+ ...o,
165+ isSelected: o.value === this.selectedCampaignId,
166+ }));
167+ this.loadSummary();
168+ this.refreshActiveSection();
169+ }
170+
171+ handleMaterialTypeChange(event) {
172+ this.selectedMaterialType = event.target.value;
173+ this.materialTypeOptions = this.materialTypeOptions.map(o => ({
174+ ...o,
175+ isSelected: o.value === this.selectedMaterialType,
176+ }));
177+ this.loadSummary();
178+ this.refreshActiveSection();
179+ }
180+
181+ handleTerritoryChange(event) {
182+ this.selectedTerritoryId = event.target.value;
183+ this.territoryOptions = this.territoryOptions.map(o => ({
184+ ...o,
185+ isSelected: o.value === this.selectedTerritoryId,
186+ }));
187+ this.loadSummary();
188+ this.refreshActiveSection();
189+ }
190+
191+ refreshActiveSection() {
192+ // Whichever of Compliance/ROI isn't the active tab always gets marked stale here — only
193+ // the active one reloads now; the inactive one reloads the next time it's opened.
194+ if (this.activeSection === "compliance") {
195+ this.loadCompliance();
196+ this._roiStale = true;
197+ } else if (this.activeSection === "roi") {
198+ this.loadRoi();
199+ this._complianceStale = true;
200+ } else {
201+ this._complianceStale = true;
202+ this._roiStale = true;
203+ }
204+ }
205+
206+ // ---- section toggle ----------------------------------------------------------------------
207+
208+ handleShowOverview() {
209+ this.activeSection = "overview";
210+ }
211+
212+ handleShowCompliance() {
213+ this.activeSection = "compliance";
214+ if (this._complianceStale) {
215+ this.loadCompliance();
216+ }
217+ }
218+
219+ handleShowRoi() {
220+ this.activeSection = "roi";
221+ if (this._roiStale) {
222+ this.loadRoi();
223+ }
224+ }
225+
226+ async loadCompliance() {
227+ const seq = ++this._complianceSeq;
228+ this.isLoadingCompliance = true;
229+ try {
230+ const dto = await getComplianceReport({
231+ campaignId: this.selectedCampaignId || null,
232+ materialType: this.selectedMaterialType || null,
233+ territoryId: this.selectedTerritoryId || null,
234+ });
235+ if (seq !== this._complianceSeq) {
236+ return;
237+ }
238+ this.complianceReport = dto;
239+ this._complianceStale = false;
240+ } catch (error) {
241+ if (seq !== this._complianceSeq) {
242+ return;
243+ }
244+ // Leave _complianceStale as-is (true) so reopening the tab retries the load.
245+ this.toast("error", "Couldn't load the compliance report", this.errorMessage(error));
246+ } finally {
247+ if (seq === this._complianceSeq) {
248+ this.isLoadingCompliance = false;
249+ }
250+ }
251+ }
252+
253+ async loadRoi() {
254+ const seq = ++this._roiSeq;
255+ this.isLoadingRoi = true;
256+ try {
257+ const dto = await getRoiAnalysis({
258+ requestJson: JSON.stringify({
259+ ...this.buildFilters(),
260+ windowWeeks: Number(this.selectedRoiWindowWeeks),
261+ }),
262+ });
263+ if (seq !== this._roiSeq) {
264+ return;
265+ }
266+ this.roiAnalysis = dto;
267+ this._roiStale = false;
268+ } catch (error) {
269+ if (seq !== this._roiSeq) {
270+ return;
271+ }
272+ // Leave _roiStale as-is (true) so reopening the tab retries the load.
273+ this.toast("error", "Couldn't load the ROI analysis", this.errorMessage(error));
274+ } finally {
275+ if (seq === this._roiSeq) {
276+ this.isLoadingRoi = false;
277+ }
278+ }
279+ }
280+
281+ handleRoiWindowChange(event) {
282+ this.selectedRoiWindowWeeks = event.target.value;
283+ this.roiWindowOptions = this.roiWindowOptions.map(o => ({
284+ ...o,
285+ isSelected: o.value === this.selectedRoiWindowWeeks,
286+ }));
287+ this.loadRoi();
288+ }
289+
290+ // ---- account detail (map pin / list row / compliance row) --------------------------------
291+
292+ handleMarkerSelect(event) {
293+ const accountId = event.detail && event.detail.selectedMarkerValue;
294+ if (accountId) {
295+ this.openAccountDetail(accountId);
296+ }
297+ }
298+
299+ handlePinListRowClick(event) {
300+ this.openAccountDetail(event.currentTarget.dataset.accountId);
301+ }
302+
303+ async openAccountDetail(accountId) {
304+ this.selectedAccountId = accountId;
305+ const pin = (this.summary && this.summary.accountPins) || [];
306+ const match = pin.find(p => p.accountId === accountId);
307+ this.selectedAccountName = match ? match.accountName : accountId;
308+ this.isLoadingHistory = true;
309+ this.history = [];
310+ try {
311+ const rows = await getAccountDeploymentHistory({ accountId });
312+ this.history = rows || [];
313+ } catch (error) {
314+ this.toast("error", "Couldn't load deployment history", this.errorMessage(error));
315+ } finally {
316+ this.isLoadingHistory = false;
317+ }
318+ }
319+
320+ handleCloseDetail() {
321+ this.selectedAccountId = null;
322+ this.selectedAccountName = null;
323+ this.history = [];
324+ }
325+
326+ // ---- CSV export (compliance rows; mirrors the pricingManager export pattern) -------------
327+
328+ _materialTypeForExport() {
329+ const opt = this.materialTypeOptions.find(o => o.isSelected);
330+ return (opt && opt.value) || "All";
331+ }
332+
333+ _exportRows() {
334+ const rows = [];
335+ const territories = (this.complianceReport && this.complianceReport.territories) || [];
336+ territories.forEach(territory => {
337+ (territory.rows || []).forEach(row => {
338+ rows.push({
339+ accountName: row.accountName || "",
340+ territoryName: territory.territoryName || "",
341+ routeName: row.routeName || "",
342+ materialType: row.materialType || this._materialTypeForExport(),
343+ status: row.status || "",
344+ expectedDate: row.expectedDate || "",
345+ actualDate: row.actualDate || "",
346+ });
347+ });
348+ });
349+ return rows;
350+ }
351+
352+ async handleExportCsv() {
353+ const rows = this._exportRows();
354+ if (rows.length === 0) {
355+ this.toast("warning", "Nothing to export", "The current compliance report has no rows");
356+ return;
357+ }
358+ const confirmed = await LightningConfirm.open({
359+ message: `Export ${rows.length} compliance row(s) as a CSV file?`,
360+ label: "Export Compliance Report",
361+ theme: "info",
362+ });
363+ if (!confirmed) {
364+ return;
365+ }
366+
367+ const header = [
368+ "Account Name",
369+ "Territory",
370+ "Route",
371+ "Material Type",
372+ "Status",
373+ "Expected Date",
374+ "Actual Date",
375+ ];
376+ const body = rows.map(r => [
377+ r.accountName,
378+ r.territoryName,
379+ r.routeName,
380+ r.materialType,
381+ r.status,
382+ r.expectedDate,
383+ r.actualDate,
384+ ]);
385+ const esc = value => {
386+ let s = value == null ? "" : String(value);
387+ // Neutralize spreadsheet formula injection: a cell starting with =, +, -, @, tab, or
388+ // CR is evaluated as a formula by Excel/Sheets — force it to text (pricingManager
389+ // export pattern, BMS-3881 review).
390+ if (/^[=+\-@\t\r]/.test(s)) {
391+ s = `'${s}`;
392+ }
393+ return /[",\n\r]/.test(s) ? `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : s;
394+ };
395+ const csv = [header, ...body].map(r => r.map(esc).join(",")).join("\r\n");
396+ const link = document.createElement("a");
397+ // data: URI (with a BOM so Excel opens it as UTF-8) instead of a Blob URL — Lightning
398+ // Web Security blocks navigation to sandbox-created blob: URLs, so a blob-href anchor
399+ // silently downloads nothing. The anchor must also be attached for the click to navigate.
400+ link.href = `data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent("\ufeff" + csv)}`;
401+ link.download = `pos-compliance-report-${this._toLocalIso(new Date())}.csv`;
402+ document.body.appendChild(link);
403+ link.click();
404+ document.body.removeChild(link);
405+ this.toast("success", "Export ready", `Exported ${rows.length} compliance row(s)`);
406+ }
407+
408+ _toLocalIso(date) {
409+ const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
410+ return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())}`;
411+ }
412+
413+ // ---- getters: summary / stats ------------------------------------------------------------
414+
415+ get hasSummary() {
416+ return !!this.summary;
417+ }
418+
419+ get showSkeleton() {
420+ return this.isInitializing;
421+ }
422+
423+ get showError() {
424+ return !this.isInitializing && !!this.loadError;
425+ }
426+
427+ get showOverview() {
428+ return this.activeSection === "overview";
429+ }
430+
431+ get showCompliance() {
432+ return this.activeSection === "compliance";
433+ }
434+
435+ get showRoi() {
436+ return this.activeSection === "roi";
437+ }
438+
439+ get overviewTabStyle() {
440+ return this.sectionTabStyle(this.showOverview);
441+ }
442+
443+ get complianceTabStyle() {
444+ return this.sectionTabStyle(this.showCompliance);
445+ }
446+
447+ get roiTabStyle() {
448+ return this.sectionTabStyle(this.showRoi);
449+ }
450+
451+ sectionTabStyle(active) {
452+ const base =
453+ "padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--ohfy-border, 177 199 235));";
454+ return active
455+ ? `${base} background: rgb(var(--ohfy-accent, 228 242 35)); color: rgb(var(--ohfy-primary, 0 0 0)); border-color: rgb(var(--ohfy-primary, 0 0 0));`
456+ : `${base} background: rgb(var(--ohfy-surface, 255 255 255)); color: rgb(var(--ohfy-text-muted, 84 84 84));`;
457+ }
458+
459+ get deploymentRateLabel() {
460+ if (!this.summary) {
461+ return "";
462+ }
463+ const rate = this.summary.deploymentRate != null ? this.summary.deploymentRate : 0;
464+ return `${this.fmt(this.summary.deployed)} of ${this.fmt(this.summary.totalAssigned)} accounts — ${rate.toFixed(1)}%`;
465+ }
466+
467+ get statCards() {
468+ if (!this.summary) {
469+ return [];
470+ }
471+ return [
472+ {
473+ key: "deployed",
474+ testId: "dash-stat-deployed",
475+ label: "Deployed",
476+ value: this.fmt(this.summary.deployed),
477+ valueStyle: "color: rgb(var(--ohfy-success, 15 110 86));",
478+ },
479+ {
480+ key: "notDeployed",
481+ testId: "dash-stat-not-deployed",
482+ label: "Not Deployed",
483+ value: this.fmt(this.summary.notDeployed),
484+ valueStyle: "color: rgb(var(--ohfy-danger, 163 45 45));",
485+ },
486+ {
487+ key: "deferred",
488+ testId: "dash-stat-deferred",
489+ label: "Deferred",
490+ value: this.fmt(this.summary.deferred),
491+ valueStyle: "color: rgb(var(--ohfy-focus-ring, 74 95 176));",
492+ },
493+ ];
494+ }
495+
496+ // ---- getters: map / pin list -------------------------------------------------------------
497+
498+ get accountPins() {
499+ return (this.summary && this.summary.accountPins) || [];
500+ }
501+
502+ get hasAccountPins() {
503+ return this.accountPins.length > 0;
504+ }
505+
506+ get noAccountPins() {
507+ return !this.hasAccountPins;
508+ }
509+
510+ get mapMarkers() {
511+ return this.accountPins
512+ .filter(p => p.latitude != null && p.longitude != null)
513+ .map(p => {
514+ const meta = STATUS_BUCKET_META[p.statusBucket] || STATUS_BUCKET_META.noAssignment;
515+ return {
516+ location: { Latitude: p.latitude, Longitude: p.longitude },
517+ title: p.accountName,
518+ description: meta.label,
519+ value: p.accountId,
520+ };
521+ });
522+ }
523+
524+ get pinListView() {
525+ return this.accountPins.map(p => {
526+ const meta = STATUS_BUCKET_META[p.statusBucket] || STATUS_BUCKET_META.noAssignment;
527+ return {
528+ ...p,
529+ statusLabel: meta.label,
530+ dotStyle: `display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: ${meta.color}; flex-shrink: 0;`,
531+ };
532+ });
533+ }
534+
535+ get legendItems() {
536+ return Object.keys(STATUS_BUCKET_META).map(key => ({
537+ key,
538+ label: STATUS_BUCKET_META[key].label,
539+ dotStyle: `display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: ${STATUS_BUCKET_META[key].color};`,
540+ }));
541+ }
542+
543+ get showDetailPanel() {
544+ return !!this.selectedAccountId;
545+ }
546+
547+ // ---- getters: compliance -------------------------------------------------------------
548+
549+ get complianceTerritories() {
550+ return ((this.complianceReport && this.complianceReport.territories) || []).map(
551+ (territory, tIdx) => ({
552+ ...territory,
553+ key: territory.territoryId || `territory-${tIdx}`,
554+ rows: (territory.rows || []).map((row, rIdx) => ({
555+ ...row,
556+ key: `${territory.territoryName || tIdx}-${rIdx}`,
557+ expectedDate: this.formatLocalDate(row.expectedDate),
558+ actualDate: this.formatDateTime(row.actualDate),
559+ })),
560+ })
561+ );
562+ }
563+
564+ get hasComplianceData() {
565+ return this.complianceTerritories.length > 0;
566+ }
567+
568+ // ---- getters: ROI ----------------------------------------------------------------------
569+
570+ get roiAccounts() {
571+ return ((this.roiAnalysis && this.roiAnalysis.accounts) || []).map((acct, idx) => ({
572+ ...acct,
573+ key: acct.accountId || `${acct.accountName || "account"}-${idx}`,
574+ }));
575+ }
576+
577+ get historyView() {
578+ return (this.history || []).map((row, idx) => ({
579+ ...row,
580+ key: `${row.itemName || "item"}-${idx}`,
581+ deployedDate: this.formatDateTime(row.deployedDate),
582+ hasTruckRoute: !!row.truckRoute,
583+ }));
584+ }
585+
586+ get hasRoiData() {
587+ return this.roiAccounts.length > 0;
588+ }
589+
590+ get roiLiftLabel() {
591+ if (!this.roiAnalysis || this.roiAnalysis.campaignLiftPct == null) {
592+ return "";
593+ }
594+ return `${this.roiAnalysis.campaignLiftPct.toFixed(1)}%`;
595+ }
596+
597+ // ---- utils -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
598+
599+ fmt(value) {
600+ return Number(value || 0).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
601+ }
602+
603+ /**
604+ * Formats an Aura-serialized Datetime value (e.g. "2026-06-01T14:32:00.000Z") for display —
605+ * "Jun 1, 2026, 2:32 PM" (localized). Null/empty/unparsable input renders as "—".
606+ */
607+ formatDateTime(value) {
608+ if (!value) {
609+ return "—";
610+ }
611+ const date = new Date(value);
612+ if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
613+ return "—";
614+ }
615+ return date.toLocaleString(undefined, {
616+ year: "numeric",
617+ month: "short",
618+ day: "numeric",
619+ hour: "numeric",
620+ minute: "2-digit",
621+ });
622+ }
623+
624+ /**
625+ * Formats an Aura-serialized Date value ("yyyy-MM-dd") for display — "Jun 1, 2026". Parses
626+ * the year/month/day as local components (rather than `new Date('yyyy-MM-dd')`, which Date
627+ * treats as UTC midnight and can render as the previous day in western timezones) to avoid
628+ * a timezone off-by-one. Null/empty/unparsable input renders as "—".
629+ */
630+ formatLocalDate(value) {
631+ if (!value) {
632+ return "—";
633+ }
634+ const parts = String(value).split("-");
635+ if (parts.length !== 3) {
636+ return "—";
637+ }
638+ const [year, month, day] = parts.map(Number);
639+ const date = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
640+ if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
641+ return "—";
642+ }
643+ return date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
644+ year: "numeric",
645+ month: "short",
646+ day: "numeric",
647+ });
648+ }
649+
650+ errorMessage(error) {
651+ return (
652+ (error && error.body && error.body.message) ||
653+ (error && error.message) ||
654+ "Something went wrong loading POS deployment data."
655+ );
656+ }
657+
658+ toast(variant, title, message) {
659+ this.dispatchEvent(new ShowToastEvent({ title, message, variant }));
660+ }
661+}

751+ /**
752+ * @description BMS-3854 (POS Deployment Visibility). Auto-links open POS_Deployment__c
753+ * assignments to the truck-bound Transfer__c row that is now carrying their
754+ * material, for any transferred Item__c flagged Is_POS_Material__c. Matches
755+ * deployments assigned to accounts served by the destination truck's route:
756+ * Delivery__c.Truck_Location__c (the destination Location__c on this truck load)
757+ * -> Delivery__c.Route__c -> Account_Route__c.Customer__c (active route stops).
758+ * Only Status__c = 'Assigned' deployments with no Transfer__c yet are touched, so
759+ * this never overwrites a manual stamp made via
760+ * POSDeploymentController.linkTransferToDeployments (kept as the fallback path
761+ * for out-of-route transfers or backfill). Best-effort: any failure here is
762+ * logged and swallowed rather than rolling back the transfer/adjustment that
763+ * already succeeded above.
764+ * @param itemIdToTransferIdMap transferred Item__c Id -> the Transfer__c Id created for it on
765+ * this truck load (one representative transfer per item is sufficient for linking).
766+ * @param truckLocationId the destination truck inventory Location__c for this load.
767+ */
768+ @TestVisible
769+ private static void linkAssignedPOSDeployments(
770+ Map<Id, Id> itemIdToTransferIdMap,
771+ Id truckLocationId
772+ ) {
773+ if (itemIdToTransferIdMap.isEmpty() || truckLocationId == null) {
774+ return;
775+ }
776+
777+ try {
778+ List<Item__c> posItems = (List<Item__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
779+ new List<String>{ 'Id' },
780+ 'Item__c'
781+ )
782+ .filters(new List<String>{ 'Id IN :itemIds', 'Is_POS_Material__c = TRUE' })
783+ .build()
784+ .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'itemIds' => itemIdToTransferIdMap.keySet() });
785+
786+ if (posItems.isEmpty()) {
787+ return;
788+ }
789+ Set<Id> posItemIds = new Map<Id, Item__c>(posItems).keySet();
790+
791+ List<Delivery__c> deliveries = (List<Delivery__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
792+ new List<String>{ 'Id', 'Route__c' },
793+ 'Delivery__c'
794+ )
795+ .filters(
796+ new List<String>{ 'Truck_Location__c = :truckLocationId', 'Route__c != null' }
797+ )
798+ .build()
799+ .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'truckLocationId' => truckLocationId });
800+
801+ if (deliveries.isEmpty()) {
802+ return;
803+ }
804+
805+ Set<Id> routeIds = new Set<Id>();
806+ for (Delivery__c delivery : deliveries) {
807+ routeIds.add(delivery.Route__c);
808+ }
809+
810+ List<Account_Route__c> accountRoutes = (List<Account_Route__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
811+ new List<String>{ 'Id', 'Customer__c' },
812+ 'Account_Route__c'
813+ )
814+ .filters(new List<String>{ 'Route__c IN :routeIds', 'Is_Active_Route__c = TRUE' })
815+ .build()
816+ .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'routeIds' => routeIds });
817+
818+ if (accountRoutes.isEmpty()) {
819+ return;
820+ }
821+
822+ Set<Id> accountIds = new Set<Id>();
823+ for (Account_Route__c accountRoute : accountRoutes) {
824+ accountIds.add(accountRoute.Customer__c);
825+ }
826+
827+ List<POS_Deployment__c> openDeployments = (List<POS_Deployment__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
828+ new List<String>{ 'Id', 'Item__c' },
829+ 'POS_Deployment__c'
830+ )
831+ .filters(
832+ new List<String>{
833+ 'Status__c = :assignedStatus',
834+ 'Transfer__c = null',
835+ 'Item__c IN :posItemIds',
836+ 'Account__c IN :accountIds'
837+ }
838+ )
839+ .build()
840+ .execute(
841+ new Map<String, Object>{
842+ 'assignedStatus' => 'Assigned',
843+ 'posItemIds' => posItemIds,
844+ 'accountIds' => accountIds
845+ }
846+ );
847+
848+ if (openDeployments.isEmpty()) {
849+ return;
850+ }
851+
852+ List<POS_Deployment__c> deploymentsToUpdate = new List<POS_Deployment__c>();
853+ for (POS_Deployment__c deployment : openDeployments) {
854+ Id transferId = itemIdToTransferIdMap.get(deployment.Item__c);
855+ if (transferId != null) {
856+ deploymentsToUpdate.add(
857+ new POS_Deployment__c(Id = deployment.Id, Transfer__c = transferId)
858+ );
859+ }
860+ }
861+
862+ if (!deploymentsToUpdate.isEmpty()) {
863+ List<Database.SaveResult> saveResults = DmlService.doUpdate(
864+ deploymentsToUpdate,
865+ false
866+ );
867+ for (Integer i = 0; i < saveResults.size(); i++) {
868+ Database.SaveResult saveResult = saveResults[i];
869+ if (!saveResult.isSuccess()) {
870+ Logger.getInstance()
871+ .error(
872+ 'TransferToTruckController.linkAssignedPOSDeployments failed to stamp Transfer__c on ' +
873+ deploymentsToUpdate[i].Id +
874+ ': ' +
875+ saveResult.getErrors()
876+ );
877+ }
878+ }
879+ Logger.getInstance().flush();
880+ }
881+ } catch (Exception e) {
882+ Logger.getInstance()
883+ .error(
884+ 'TransferToTruckController.linkAssignedPOSDeployments failed to auto-link POS deployments',
885+ e
886+ );
887+ Logger.getInstance().flush();
888+ // Best-effort only — the transfer and inventory adjustment above already succeeded;
889+ // POSDeploymentController.linkTransferToDeployments remains available to stamp the
890+ // Transfer__c lookup manually afterward.
891+ }
892+ }

docs/product/oms/pos-deployment-visibility/setup.md+59-0
@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
1+# POS Deployment Visibility — Setup
2+
3+Admin setup and configuration for the POS Deployment Visibility feature (BMS-3854).
4+
5+## Schema added
6+
7+| Object | Field | Purpose |
8+| ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
9+| `POS_Campaign__c` | `Name`, `Start_Date__c`, `End_Date__c`, `Deployment_Deadline__c`, `Status__c` | Defines a POS deployment campaign window |
10+| `POS_Deployment__c` | `Account__c` (Master-Detail) | The account the placement is assigned to |
11+| `POS_Deployment__c` | `Item__c` (Lookup, required) | The POS material being deployed |
12+| `POS_Deployment__c` | `POS_Campaign__c` (Lookup) | Links the assignment to its campaign |
13+| `POS_Deployment__c` | `Quantity_Assigned__c`, `Placement_Instructions__c` | What/how to place |
14+| `POS_Deployment__c` | `Status__c` (Picklist) | Assigned / Deployed / Not Deployed / Deferred / Cancelled |
15+| `POS_Deployment__c` | `Reason_Code__c` (Picklist) | Account Refused / No Space / Material Damaged / Other |
16+| `POS_Deployment__c` | `Expected_Deployment_Date__c`, `Deployed_Date__c`, `Deployed_By__c` | Planned vs. actual deployment tracking |
17+| `POS_Deployment__c` | `Deployment_Location__c`, `Is_Photo_Attached__c` | Geolocation + photo-captured flag from the driver capture screen |
18+| `POS_Deployment__c` | `Invoice_Item__c`, `Transfer__c` | Links back to the order line / warehouse transfer that fulfilled it |
19+| `POS_Deployment__c` | `Is_Conflict__c`, `Conflict_Reason__c` | Set when an offline-queued update collides with a change made elsewhere |
20+| `Item__c` | `Is_POS_Material__c` (Checkbox) | Marks an item as POS material (drives the `transferToTruck` badge and dashboard filters) |
21+
22+## 1. POS Deployment Dashboard tab / app page — not packaged, deploy manually per org
23+
24+Following the same pattern as `POS_Ordering` (see `docs/product/oms/pos-ordering/setup.md`), the `POS_Deployment_Dashboard` FlexiPage and its `POS_Deployment_Dashboard` tab are **not** part of the `OHFY-OMS-UI` managed package. They live at `org-metadata/managed/{flexipages,tabs}/POS_Deployment_Dashboard.*` (and the `org-metadata/scratch/` mirror for internal scratch/CI orgs) — see `docs/engineering/reference/namespace-handling.md`.
25+
26+**Per-org setup (config team, after package install):**
27+
28+1. Retrieve/deploy `org-metadata/managed/flexipages/POS_Deployment_Dashboard.flexipage-meta.xml` and `org-metadata/managed/tabs/POS_Deployment_Dashboard.tab` into the target org.
29+2. Add the page to a Lightning app's navigation: **Setup → Lightning App Builder → open the page → Activation → "Lightning Experience" tab → select the app(s) → "Add page to app" → Save.** Deploying the FlexiPage/tab metadata alone is not sufficient — without this step the tab won't resolve when opened.
30+3. Alternatively, users can reach it via **App Launcher → "POS Deployment Dashboard"** once the tab is deployed.
31+
32+The underlying LWCs remain packaged and namespace-safe: `posDeploymentCapture` (driver-facing, place on a mobile record page or utility bar) and `posDeploymentDashboard` (management-facing, hosted by the FlexiPage above).
33+
34+## 2. Permission set — `POS_Deployment_Visibility` — packaged
35+
36+Unlike `POS_Ordering_Access`, this permission set **is** part of the managed package (`OHFY-OMS-UI/force-app/main/default/permissionsets/POS_Deployment_Visibility.permissionset-meta.xml`). Per the 2GP master-detail constraint (CLAUDE.md rule 8 / BMS-5628 precedent), it grants:
37+
38+- **`POS_Deployment__c`** — field-level security only, no `objectPermissions` (it's a Master-Detail child of `Account`; record access flows down from the `Account` Read grant).
39+- **`POS_Campaign__c`** — full object + field permissions (it's a standalone lookup target, not an M-D detail).
40+
41+**Per-org setup (config team, after package install):**
42+
43+```bash
44+sf org assign permset -n POS_Deployment_Visibility -o <alias>
45+```
46+
47+Assign to drivers (for `posDeploymentCapture`) and merchandising/management users (for `posDeploymentDashboard`). Also grant Read on `Account`, `Item__c` (including `Is_POS_Material__c`), and `Territory__c` as needed for territory filtering.
48+
49+## 3. Campaign setup
50+
51+Create a `POS_Campaign__c` record with `Start_Date__c`, `End_Date__c`, and `Deployment_Deadline__c` before assigning deployments — the dashboard's Overview/Compliance/ROI sections all filter by campaign.
52+
53+## 4. Assigning deployments
54+
55+`POS_Deployment__c` records are typically created from a WMS transfer/pick flow (stamping `Transfer__c`/`Invoice_Item__c`) or bulk-loaded per campaign, with `Account__c`, `Item__c`, `POS_Campaign__c`, and `Expected_Deployment_Date__c` populated. Drivers then confirm placement via `posDeploymentCapture`.
56+
57+## 5. Warehouse-to-truck auto-link — no new permission needed
58+
59+`TransferToTruckController.transferToTruck` (OHFY-WMS) now auto-links any open (`Status__c = 'Assigned'`, unlinked) `POS_Deployment__c` to the truck-bound `Transfer__c` it creates, for POS-material items (`Item__c.Is_POS_Material__c`) whose account is served by the destination truck's route (`Delivery__c.Truck_Location__c` → `Route__c` → `Account_Route__c.Customer__c`). This runs as the transferring warehouse user, through `QueryService`/`DmlService` at the dynamic default `AccessLevel` — it reads/writes the same `POS_Deployment__c`/`Transfer__c` fields the WMS transfer flow and the `POS_Deployment_Visibility` permission set already grant, so **no additional permission set assignment is required**. It's best-effort: a lookup miss (no matching route, no open deployment) is a silent no-op, and the existing manual "link transfer to deployments" action on the dashboard remains available as a fallback for out-of-route transfers or backfill.
docs/product/oms/pos-deployment-visibility/usage.md+61-0
@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
1+# POS Deployment Visibility — Usage
2+
3+## What it does
4+
5+Tracks point-of-sale / merchandising material deployments — shelf talkers, cooler decals, tap handles — from assignment through field confirmation to a management rollup, so merchandising can see **what got placed, where, by whom, and whether it moved volume**.
6+
7+A **POS Campaign** (`POS_Campaign__c`) is the header: a run of materials with a start date, end date, and deployment deadline. Each account/material assignment under it is a **POS Deployment** (`POS_Deployment__c`) — the item, quantity, placement instructions, and a status that the driver updates in the field.
8+
9+| Surface | Who | What |
10+| ---------------------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
11+| **POS Deployment Capture** | Driver | Confirm each assigned material's deployment at the account |
12+| **POS Deployment Dashboard** | Merchandising / management | Deployment-rate summary, account map, compliance report, ROI analysis |
13+
14+## How to use it
15+
16+### 1. Confirm a deployment (driver)
17+
18+The **POS Deployment Capture** component lives on the Account record page (and can be embedded on an app page, e.g. at a delivery stop). It lists every POS material assigned to the account with its placement instructions. For each item the driver taps one of three actions:
19+
20+- **Deployed** — the material was placed as instructed.
21+- **Not Deployed** — requires picking a **reason**: Account Refused, No Space, Material Damaged, or Other.
22+- **Deferred** — postponed to a later visit, not abandoned.
23+
24+A photo can be attached per item before saving. **Save** is disabled until every changed row has a valid status (and a reason, if Not Deployed) — it commits all changed rows at once.
25+
26+On save, each row is stamped with:
27+
28+- A client timestamp and the driver's **geolocation** — best-effort: on a phone running the Salesforce mobile app it uses the device's native location service, falling back to the browser's location API on desktop or if the mobile service is unavailable. A denied or timed-out location request doesn't block the save; the row just saves without coordinates.
29+- The deploying driver (`Deployed_By__c`) and, for Deployed rows, the actual deployment date (`Deployed_Date__c`) against the assignment's expected date.
30+
31+**Works offline.** If the driver saves with no connection (or the save call fails with a network-shaped error), the update is queued to the device and synced automatically the next time the device is back online — no re-entry needed. The header shows a pending-sync count while updates are queued, and a **"N of N uploaded"** toast confirms the result once the sync runs. If the sync partially fails, the failing rows are flagged **"Not Saved"** in the list so the driver knows to retry them.
32+
33+**Conflict flagging.** If a POS deployment assignment was cancelled by someone else while the driver was offline, the queued update is rejected as a conflict rather than silently applied — the row is flagged so the driver can review it instead of the update disappearing without explanation.
34+
35+### 2. Monitor deployment progress (merchandising / management)
36+
37+The **POS Deployment Dashboard** (App Launcher → "POS Deployment Dashboard", or an app-page/home-page tile) gives a filterable, real-time view across every campaign.
38+
39+**Filters** — Campaign, Material Type (Merchandise / Tap Handle), and Territory — narrow every section below them.
40+
41+**Overview** shows:
42+
43+- A deployment-rate headline, e.g. **"78 of 112 accounts — 69.6%"**.
44+- Stat tiles for Deployed / Not Deployed / Deferred counts.
45+- An account map with a color-coded legend (green = Deployed, red = Not Deployed, yellow = Deferred, gray = No Assignment) and an always-visible pin list alongside the map (marker colors on the map itself can't be recolored, so the list is the reliable read). Clicking a pin or list row opens that account's deployment history.
46+
47+![POS Deployment Dashboard overview — deployment-rate summary, stat tiles, and the account map with legend](./dashboard-overview-map.png)
48+
49+**Deployment history and warehouse fulfillment (BMS-3854).** When POS materials for an assigned campaign are routed to an account via a warehouse-to-truck transfer (rather than riding along on an invoice line), the transfer is now tracked as an actual inventory movement: the material's `Transfer__c` line items decrement the warehouse's `Inventory__c` balance for that item like any other transfer, and the fulfilling `POS_Deployment__c` assignment is auto-linked to the transfer as soon as the warehouse manager submits the truck load — no manual step required, as long as the account is on the destination truck's route. Once linked, the account's deployment history panel shows a **"Fulfilled via Route \<#\> — \<Truck\>"** line under the item/campaign row, so merchandising can trace a deployment back to the exact truck run that carried the material. Out-of-route transfers (or historical backfill) can still be linked manually via the existing transfer-linking action; nothing about that path changed.
50+
51+**Compliance Report** (toggle to the "Compliance" section) is grouped by territory, each with a compliance percentage, and lists per-account rows: expected vs. actual deployment date, reason code (if not deployed), the deploying driver, and whether a photo was captured. It exports to **CSV**.
52+
53+![Compliance Report — per-territory compliance percentage and per-account expected vs. actual deployment detail](./compliance-report.png)
54+
55+**ROI Analysis** (toggle to the "ROI" section) compares the 4-week average case-equivalent volume before vs. after deployment for accounts that received a Deployed placement in the campaign, against a control group of accounts in the same territory that weren't part of the campaign. The campaign-level lift is a difference-in-differences — the treatment group's own pre→post change minus the control group's — so a territory-wide trend both groups would have seen anyway doesn't get credited to the campaign.
56+
57+## Limitations / known behavior
58+
59+- **Control group reference date** — control accounts have no deployment date of their own, so they're compared against the _average_ deployment date of the treatment group in the same scope. This is a proxy for "what would have happened at the same point in time," not an exact per-account match.
60+- **Route on a compliance row** — when an account has multiple active routes, the compliance report shows the first one found; it's a label, not a full route roster.
61+- **Photo capture is a flag, not a gallery** — the compliance report and capture screen track _whether_ a photo was attached (`Is_Photo_Attached__c`), not a browsable image gallery.

test-automation/tests/oms/pos-deployment-dashboard.spec.ts+127-0
@@ -0,0 +1,127 @@
1+// @covers OHFY-OMS-UI/lwc/posDeploymentDashboard
2+// @covers OHFY-OMS-UI/lwc/posDeploymentCapture
3+import { test, expect, type SfPage } from "../../fixtures/salesforce.fixture";
4+import { runSfQuery } from "../../support/sfCli";
5+
6+/**
7+ * E2E for POS Deployment Visibility (BMS-3854).
8+ *
9+ * Surfaces under test live on the POS Deployment Dashboard app page (flexipage
10+ * `POS_Deployment_Dashboard`):
11+ * - posDeploymentDashboard — Overview (deployment-rate + map/pin list), Compliance Report
12+ * (per-territory rows + CSV export), ROI Analysis (before/after lift vs. control group)
13+ *
14+ * Requires at least one `ohfy__POS_Campaign__c` with linked `ohfy__POS_Deployment__c` rows
15+ * (see the BMS-3854 seed script referenced in the PR). The spec skips gracefully when the
16+ * tab or seed data isn't present (fresh pool claims may lack the app page until the
17+ * snapshot refreshes, or a pool org may not have campaign data seeded).
18+ */
19+const ORG = process.env.SF_ORG_ALIAS || "ohfy-dev";
20+const TAB = "POS_Deployment_Dashboard";
21+
22+let HAS_CAMPAIGN = false;
23+
24+test.beforeAll(async () => {
25+ const rows = runSfQuery("SELECT Id FROM ohfy__POS_Campaign__c LIMIT 1", ORG);
26+ HAS_CAMPAIGN = rows.length > 0;
27+});
28+
29+/** Opens the dashboard tab, skipping when it isn't deployed/visible or seeded in this org. */
30+async function openDashboard(sfPage: SfPage) {
31+ test.skip(!HAS_CAMPAIGN, "No ohfy__POS_Campaign__c records — load BMS-3854 seed data first.");
32+ const resolved = await sfPage.resolveTabApiName(TAB);
33+ test.skip(!resolved, "POS_Deployment_Dashboard tab not deployed/visible in this org.");
34+ await sfPage.goToApp(`/lightning/n/${resolved}`);
35+ await expect(
36+ sfPage.getByText("POS Deployment Visibility", { exact: true }).first()
37+ ).toBeVisible({
38+ timeout: 60_000,
39+ });
40+ // The header text above renders synchronously, before getCampaigns()/loadSummary() resolve —
41+ // wait for the deployment-rate tile too, since it only appears once the async default-campaign
42+ // load finishes. Without this, Compliance/ROI/filter assertions below race the load and can
43+ // misread "still loading" as "no data for this campaign" (a skip, not a failure).
44+ await expect(sfPage.getByTestId("dash-deployment-rate")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 });
45+}
46+
47+test.describe("POS Deployment Dashboard — BMS-3854", () => {
48+ test("Overview shows a deployment-rate summary and account pins", async ({ sfPage }) => {
49+ await openDashboard(sfPage);
50+
51+ await expect(sfPage.getByTestId("dash-section-overview")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15_000 });
52+ // openDashboard() already waited for dash-deployment-rate.
53+
54+ // Pool orgs without seeded pins show the empty state instead — skip rather than fail.
55+ const noPins = sfPage.getByTestId("dash-no-pins");
56+ const firstPin = sfPage.getByTestId("dash-pin-row").first();
57+ await expect(firstPin.or(noPins)).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15_000 });
58+ test.skip(
59+ await noPins.isVisible().catch(() => false),
60+ "No account pins for the seeded campaign in this org."
61+ );
62+ await expect(firstPin).toBeVisible();
63+ });
64+
65+ test("Compliance Report lists per-account rows grouped by territory", async ({ sfPage }) => {
66+ await openDashboard(sfPage);
67+
68+ await sfPage.getByTestId("dash-section-compliance").click();
69+
70+ const emptyState = sfPage.getByTestId("dash-compliance-empty");
71+ const territoryGroup = sfPage.getByTestId("dash-compliance-territory").first();
72+ await expect(territoryGroup.or(emptyState)).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15_000 });
73+ test.skip(
74+ await emptyState.isVisible().catch(() => false),
75+ "No compliance rows for the seeded campaign in this org."
76+ );
77+ await expect(territoryGroup).toBeVisible();
78+ await expect(sfPage.getByTestId("dash-compliance-row").first()).toBeVisible();
79+
80+ // CSV export button is present and enabled once compliance data is loaded.
81+ await expect(sfPage.getByTestId("dash-export-csv")).toBeVisible();
82+ });
83+
84+ test("ROI Analysis compares treatment vs. control account volume", async ({ sfPage }) => {
85+ await openDashboard(sfPage);
86+
87+ await sfPage.getByTestId("dash-section-roi").click();
88+
89+ const emptyState = sfPage.getByTestId("dash-roi-empty");
90+ const liftSummary = sfPage.getByTestId("dash-roi-lift");
91+ await expect(liftSummary.or(emptyState)).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15_000 });
92+ test.skip(
93+ await emptyState.isVisible().catch(() => false),
94+ "No Deployed placements for the seeded campaign in this org — nothing to compare."
95+ );
96+ await expect(liftSummary).toBeVisible();
97+ await expect(sfPage.getByTestId("dash-roi-account-row").first()).toBeVisible();
98+ });
99+
100+ test("Campaign, material type and territory filters narrow the dashboard", async ({
101+ sfPage,
102+ }) => {
103+ await openDashboard(sfPage);
104+
105+ const campaignSelect = sfPage.getByTestId("dash-campaign-select");
106+ await expect(campaignSelect).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15_000 });
107+ const optionCount = await campaignSelect.locator("option").count();
108+ test.skip(optionCount < 2, "Only one campaign in this org — nothing to filter between.");
109+
110+ // The dashboard defaults the campaign filter to the most recent campaign (not "All
111+ // campaigns"), so index 1 may already be selected — pick whichever option isn't the
112+ // current value to guarantee this actually exercises a filter change.
113+ const currentValue = await campaignSelect.inputValue();
114+ const targetIndex = await campaignSelect
115+ .locator("option")
116+ .evaluateAll(
117+ (opts, current) => opts.findIndex(o => (o as HTMLOptionElement).value !== current),
118+ currentValue
119+ );
120+ test.skip(targetIndex < 0, "No alternate campaign option available to switch to.");
121+
122+ await campaignSelect.selectOption({ index: targetIndex });
123+ // Re-selecting a campaign re-fetches the summary; the deployment-rate tile is the
124+ // readiness signal that the dashboard finished reloading for the new selection.
125+ await expect(sfPage.getByTestId("dash-deployment-rate")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15_000 });
126+ });
127+});
